title: 「冬日開懷集」系列：SSAK創意劇團《幻想空間》（韓國）
title_en: 'Cheers!' Series: "Dream Space" by Creative Group SSAK (Korea)
description:
*ੈ✩‧₊ 偶戲 × 形體劇場  三個篇章活現舞台 ✧:･ﾟ*

 * ꕤꔛ 榮獲2025年愛丁堡藝穗節戲劇獎 ꔛꕤ *

一齣跨越語言與年齡界限的無對白作品，以優美的舞台意象，帶領大小觀眾走進充滿無限想像的劇場世界！

旅程由道門弟子對抗風暴的傳說揭開序幕，繼而遇上漂流荒島的求生者，最後潛入夢幻海洋，見證巨鯨與孤獨女孩之間溫柔動人的相遇。作品交織幽默、驚喜與詩意，訴說關於勇氣、選擇、友誼與想像的故事。 *ੈ✩‧₊ Puppetry × Physical Theatre   Three vivid episodes brought to life on stage ✧:･ﾟ*

 * ꕤꔛ Winner of the Edinburgh Festival Fringe Theatre Award 2025! ꔛꕤ *

A non-verbal performance that beautifully transcends language and age barriers, inviting audiences of all ages into a richly imaginative theatrical world!

The journey begins with the legend of a disciple battling a raging storm, then moves to survivors stranded on a desert island, and finally plunging into a dreamlike ocean, where a giant whale and a lonely girl form a tender and touching bond.  Weaving together humour, surprise and poetry, the production tells stories of courage, choice, friendship and imagination.

title: 「冬日開懷集」系列: 泡泡實驗室《玩轉太空泡泡Show》（澳洲）
title_en: ‘Cheers!’ Series: "Bubble Show in Space" by Bubble Laboratory (Australia)
description:
擁「泡」浩瀚星空，走進夢幻泡泡宇宙！
 
小丑奶昔夢想摘下天上的星星，於是請好友泡泡博士幫忙。二人乘坐自製的泡泡火箭，展開奇妙的太空旅程，穿梭行星與太陽系，經歷一連串驚喜滿載的泡泡歷險！他們在途中更發現神奇機器，不但能把泡泡變成太空頭盔，還可以將人變成木偶！

《玩轉太空泡泡Show》帶來直衝10米高空的泡泡火箭、方形泡泡、橫跨半空的巨型泡泡橋，以及足以容納數人的超級泡泡！壓軸「百萬泡泡派對」更讓泡泡漫天飛舞，邀請大小朋友走入繽紛泡影，盡情狂歡！

- 演出尾聲將有細小泡泡飄落觀眾席。
- 節目有激光效果。 Embrace a universe of bubbles, and step into a dreamlike bubble cosmos!

Milkshake the Bubble Clown dreams of catching a star from the sky, so she asks her friend Dr Bubble for help.  Together, they build a bubble rocket and blast off on a magical journey through planets and solar systems, embarking on a series of surprise-filled bubble adventures!  Along the way, they discover incredible machines that can turn bubbles into space helmets and people into puppets!

Bubble Show in Space features a flying bubble rocket that launches 10 metres into the air, square bubbles, a giant bubble bridge arching overhead, and super-sized bubbles big enough to fit several people inside!  The spectacular Million Bubble Party finale fills the air with shimmering bubbles, inviting audiences of all ages to revel in the fun!

- Please be aware that tiny bubbles will fall on audience members at the end of the show.
- The performance contains laser effects.

title: 「冬日開懷集」系列：保羅納尼劇團《芙烈達的奇幻旅程》（丹麥）
title_en: ‘Cheers!’ Series: "Frida's Incredible Journey" by Paolo Nani Teater (Denmark)
description:
˗ˏˋ ꒰ ✉︎ ꒱ ˎˊ˗ 打開神秘來信，開啟奇幻之旅！

《芙烈達的奇幻旅程》以充滿玩味和手作感的繽紛視覺世界，講述一個無需言語、關於友誼力量的奇妙故事，邀請大小朋友和芙烈達一同啟程！

一天早上，芙烈達從她居住的大衣裏醒來，意外收到一封神秘來信——原來是很久以前搬到世界另一端的摯友卡洛斯寄來的，邀請她前去探望！芙烈達立刻帶上母雞、貓咪和神奇行李箱，滿心歡喜地出發。可是，這趟旅程遠比想像中更不簡單：一路上怪事連連、驚喜處處，還有意想不到的挑戰等着她。芙烈達會遇見誰？又能否順利抵達卡洛斯身邊？ ˗ˏˋ ꒰ ✉︎ ꒱ ˎˊ˗ Open a mysterious letter and begin a magical journey!

Frida's Incredible Journey is a playful, handmade story about the power of friendship, conveyed through a wordless, colourful visual universe.  Children and grown-ups are invited to join Frida on this delightful journey!

One morning, when Frida wakes up and comes out of the coat she lives in, she mysteriously receives a letter. The letter is from her best friend Carlos, who moved to a faraway country on the other side of the world long ago.  Now, he is inviting her to come and visit him.  Frida immediately packs up her hen and cat, grabs her magical suitcase and happily sets off on her journey.  However, she soon discovers that the journey is full of surprises and far more challenging than she had imagined.  Who will she meet?  And will she make all the way to Carlos?

title: 《HKGNA 音樂節 2026 - 「共鳴無界」開幕音樂會》
title_en: "HKGNA Music Festival 2026 Opening Concert - Inspirational Breaking Boundaries Concert"
description: 為「HKGNA 音樂節 2026」撼動揭幕！這場音樂會將連繫不同文化，打破重重界限！韓國跨界明星小提琴家兼歌手 Danny Koo 與跨界男高音 Phillip Jeong 將跨海登台，聯同香港頂尖音樂家陣容：香港著名唱作人馮穎琪、小提琴/中提琴家凌顯祐、薩克管名家孫穎麟、HKGNA 國際音樂大賽大獎得主鋼琴家溫文昊及 HKGNA 弦樂小組同台獻藝。貫徹本年度音樂節的主題，來自匡智會、心光盲人院暨學校與香港展能藝術會的年輕生命勇士亦將登台，攜手締造一個展現多元、堅韌與卓越音樂造詣的動人舞台。 Kick off the HKGNA Music Festival 2026 with a landmark concert that bridges cultures and breaks down barriers! Headlining the night are Korean crossover stars Danny Koo (violin/vocals) and Phillip Jeong (tenor), alongside Hong Kong-acclaimed multifaceted artist Vicky Fung (vocal), luminaries Andrew Ling (violin/viola), Timothy Sun (saxophone), HKGNA International Music Competition Grand Prize winner Alex Wun (piano), and the HKGNA Strings Ensemble. True to this year’s theme, the stage will also spotlight inspiring young talents from the Hong Chi Association, Ebenezer School & Home for the Visually Impaired, and Arts with the Disabled Association Hong Kong, creating an extraordinary platform that celebrates diversity, resilience, and musical excellence.

title: 《乒乓男兒》
description:
「乒乓球，是只有『一瞬間』的運動！」

大專學界展開了一場意想不到的對決——過氣天才潘浩德歸來，迎戰港隊成員張立君，誓要扭轉力不從心的人生！隨著熱血新人歐陽毅恆出現，大學最後一年波瀾四起，就連好友陳家明的球痴之魂也被喚醒！日常時光飛逝，一如高速閃現的乒乓來回，恍神之間已到關鍵時刻。在球場上交錯的四人，能否把握擊球的一瞬間，跨越人生界限？

《乒乓男兒》磨劍三年，先後獲香港話劇團邀請及自家製作讀劇試演，皆獲大量好評。來到2026年，劇作榮獲中國香港乒乓總會及香港代表隊支持，結合劇場科技，與觀眾一同在這充滿不確定性的時代裡，尋找立足當下、啟迪未來的最強絕招。 "Ping pong is all about an instant!"

An unexpected showdown unfolds at the University Table Tennis Championship: Former prodigy POON is making his return to the court, taking on Hong Kong team player CHEUNG! With the attempt to turn around the days in his pre-graduated year, it all starts from the appearing of the passionate newcomer AU-YEUNG, and also the reigniting of CHAN's oul of a ping-pong nut. Time flies like the ball flashing on the court, the four young men suddenly find themselves at the Match Point of life. Can they seize the instant to open a bright chapter?

“Ping Pong” has earned enthusiastic responses from audiences in its Reading Performance held by the Hong Kong Repertory Theatre and Theatre Formula, and till now, the work is brought to stage with the support of the Hong Kong, China Table Tennis Association and the Hong Kong Table Tennis Team.

description:
敦煌是古代絲綢之路的重鎮，以其豐富的文化遺產聞名於世。敦煌石窟壁畫中描繪的生活場景、奇珍異寶和官員百姓等，皆是古代社會生活的縮影，展現了敦煌作為絲綢之路重要節點的多元文化，立體地呈現昔日的社會面貌。是次巡迴展覽以圖板為基礎，精選敦煌石窟壁畫珍品作為切入點，重現隋唐豐富多彩的生活圖景，帶領觀眾穿越時空，一窺千年前的盛世風貌，沉浸於敦煌藝術與隋唐社會的開放與繁榮之中。

這個展覽亦是弘揚中華文化系列的活動之一。康文署一直積極推廣中國歷史和文化，透過舉辦多元化的節目和活動，讓市民認識博大精深的中華文化，想獲得更多資訊，請瀏覽網頁 https://ccpo.gov.hk/tc. Dunhuang, a pivotal hub along the ancient Silk Road, is renowned worldwide for its rich cultural heritage. The murals within the Dunhuang Caves depict scenes of daily life, rare treasures and figures ranging from officials to common folk. These portrayals encapsulate the ancient society, showcasing the multicultural tapestry of Dunhuang as an important stop on the Silk Road and offering a glimpse into the social landscape of the past. This roving exhibition uses panels to showcase the exquisite murals from the Dunhuang Caves, recreating the rich tapestry of life during the Sui and Tang dynasties. It guides audiences to explore the splendour of a millennium past, immersing themselves in Dunhuang art and the openness and prosperity of Sui and Tang society.

The exhibition is also one of the activities in the Chinese Culture Promotion Series. The LCSD has long been promoting Chinese history and culture through organising an array of programmes and activities to enable the public to learn more about the broad and profound Chinese culture. For more information, please visit https://ccpo.gov.hk/en.

title: 《薛寶釵，這個人》
description:
林奕華可能是經歷曹雪芹的《紅樓夢》搬上舞台最多次的香港劇場導演。始於1986年身為進念．二十面體創作人員的《石頭記》，2011年的《賈寶玉》，2014年的《紅樓夢What Is Sex》，2021年的《寶玉，你好》。來到2026年，在《石頭記》的四十年後，他的第五度「紅樓夢劇場之旅」，是《薛寶釵，這個人》。

為什麼是《薛寶釵，這個人》？林奕華給出三個答案：

第一，「紅樓夢」從女媧補天開始，那三萬六千五百零一塊的石頭，化身成玉，跟著神瑛使者化身賈寶玉，薛寶釵和「他」的關係，儼如人間的女媧，也是在「補」。

第二，有「補」必有「洞」，必有「縫」，「紅樓夢」中的人際關係錯綜複雜，薛寶釵的存在，既是為了解決問題，也是問題所在。

第三，有人的地方就有矛盾紛爭，薛寶釵作客大觀園，還是捲入是非角力的漩渦，有關「薛寶釵這個人」的言行作為，是千真萬確，是捕風捉影？

誰不想一生都在別人眼中看見像「薛寶釵」那樣近乎完美的自己？誰又想一生都像「薛寶釵」，活在別人對自己的各種評斷甚至誤解之中？

《薛寶釵，這個人》將把薛寶釵的「生平」，放在現代人的「觀看」模式和情境中上演，飾演「薛寶釵」的是劇中的一群「演員」，飾演這些「演員」的，有李心潔、路嘉欣、時一修、趙逸嵐、王宏元、黃人傑、黃峻傑、羅𤋮彥和祝家樂。現場鋼琴伴奏阿超。

《薛寶釵，這個人》的「生平」，將由九首陳建騏作曲，林奕華作詞的歌曲串起，它們是《天衣無縫》、《終身誤》、《別叫我姐姐》、《太多男孩》、《難得我多情如此》、《Frozen》、《第四十五回》、《他的最愛》及《薛寶釵，這個人》。

title: 「香港藝術家」系列2026：朱仟青《如何建造______》、吳希維《致：》
title_en: “Hong Kong Artists” Series 2026: “How to Build a ______” by Ching Chu and “Dear,” by Rosalie Ng
description:
✧˚ ༘ ⋆｡˚ 新進編舞雙舞作✧˚ ༘ ⋆｡˚ 
 

朱仟青《如何建造______》和吳希維《致：》為康文署今年「香港藝術家」系列推出的新進編舞雙舞作節目，為本地年青編舞提供製作機會，支援新進編舞以專業製作規格創作新編中型作品，透過藝術顧問的持續輔導，提升創作質素及製作能力。參與編舞從中獲得完整的專業製作經驗，提升創作及製作統籌能力，建立與不同領域藝術家的合作關係，擴闊創作視野。


《如何建造______》取材自日常工具操作與五金工場勞動，是一場關於身體、技術能力與性別預期相互碰撞的演出，結合任務式動作、材料探索與工場式舞台，呈現女性身體作為具操作性與應變解難的存在。

《致：》探索失去過後的漫長餘震；過去的記憶在生活之間悄然滲入之際，某些東西又正在悄悄溜走，也許是一個人、一段關係、一個曾經的自己。在似乎無法逃離、隨時來臨的告別跟前，我們可以怎樣與之共存？


每場演出全長約1小時15分鐘，包括中場休息15分鐘。

觀眾務請準時入座，遲到及中途離座者須待中場休息或適當時候方可進場/返回座位。主辦機構有權拒絕遲到者進場或決定其進場的時間及方式。

主辦機構有權更改節目及更換表演者。

本節目內容不反映康樂及文化事務署的意見。 ✧˚ ༘ ⋆｡˚ Double Bill of Choreographic New Voices✧˚ ༘ ⋆｡˚ 
 

How to Build a ______ by Ching Chu and Dear, by Rosalie Ng, a double bill of choreographic new voices, is a featured programme of LCSD’s “Hong Kong Artists” Series, which offers a platform for local young choreographers to develop new medium scale dance works in a professional setting. Through ongoing mentorship from artistic advisor, the choreographers elevate creative quality, gain comprehensive professional production experience, build collaborative relationships with artists across disciplines, and broaden their creative horizons.


How to Build a ______ draws from everyday tool operation and physical hardware labour, exploring collision between the body, technical skill, and gendered expectations, presenting the female body as operational and adaptable.

Dear, explores the long aftershock that follows loss. As memories of the past quietly seep into daily life, something else is also slipping away—perhaps a person, a relationship, or a former version of oneself. Faced with farewells that feel inescapable and may arrive at any moment, how might we learn to live alongside them?


The running time of each performance is approximately 1 hours and 15 minutes including an intermission of 15 minutes.

Members of the audience are strongly advised to arrive punctually.  Latecomers and those who leave their seats during the performance will only be admitted and allowed to return to their seats respectively during the intermission or at a suitable break.  The presenter reserves the right to refuse admission of latecomers, or determine the time and manner of admission of latecomers. 

The presenter reserves the right to change the programme and substitute artists.

The content of the programme does not represent the views of the Leisure and Cultural Services Department.

《如何建造______》取材自日常工具操作與五金工場勞動，是一場關於身體、技術能力與性別預期相互碰撞的演出，結合任務式動作、材料探索與工場式舞台，呈現女性身體作為具操作性與應變解難的存在。

《致：》探索失去過後的漫長餘震；過去的記憶在生活之間悄然滲入之際，某些東西又正在悄悄溜走，也許是一個人、一段關係、一個曾經的自己。在似乎無法逃離、隨時來臨的告別跟前，我們可以怎樣與之共存？

本節目內容不反映康樂及文化事務署的意見。 ✧˚ ༘ ⋆｡˚ Double Bill of Choreographic New Voices✧˚ ༘ ⋆｡˚ 
 

How to Build a ______ by Ching Chu and Dear, by Rosalie Ng, a double bill of choreographic new voices, is a featured programme of LCSD’s “Hong Kong Artists” Series, which offers a platform for local young choreographers to develop new medium scale dance works in a professional setting. Through ongoing mentorship from artistic advisor, the choreographers elevate creative quality, gain comprehensive professional production experience, build collaborative relationships with artists across disciplines, and broaden their creative horizons.


How to Build a ______ draws from everyday tool operation and physical hardware labour, exploring collision between the body, technical skill, and gendered expectations, presenting the female body as operational and adaptable.

Dear, explores the long aftershock that follows loss. As memories of the past quietly seep into daily life, something else is also slipping away—perhaps a person, a relationship, or a former version of oneself. Faced with farewells that feel inescapable and may arrive at any moment, how might we learn to live alongside them?

The presenter reserves the right to refuse admission of latecomers, or determine the time and manner of admission of latecomers.

title: 《漢字的奧秘》巡迴展覽
description:
漢字的發展歷程悠久而豐富，從新石器晚期的陶文，至商周時期的甲骨文和金文，再由秦一統後的小篆發展至秦漢間的隸變等。到唐代，漢字的書寫系統已發展成熟，書法藝術更達到巔峰。漢字一直沿用至今，其綿延不絕的生命力，承載著前人的智慧，更體現了中華文化的魅力。展覽將利用簡易的文字、文物圖片及生動的繪畫，向公眾闡釋漢字的發展和文化內涵。

這個展覽亦是弘揚中華文化系列的活動之一。康文署一直積極推廣中國歷史和文化，透過舉辦多元化的節目和活動，讓市民認識博大精深的中華文化，想獲得更多資訊，請瀏覽網頁https://ccpo.gov.hk/tc。

弘揚中華文化辦公室及中國文字博物館聯合籌劃 The development of Chinese characters has a long and rich history, beginning with the pottery inscriptions in the late Neolithic period, progressing to the oracle bone scripts and bronze inscriptions in the Shang and Zhou dynasties, and evolving through small seal scripts after the unification by Qin to clerical scripts during the Qin and Han periods. By the Tang dynasty, Chinese writing system had fully matured and the art of calligraphy scaled new heights. As of today, Chinese characters continue to embody the wisdom of the past and demonstrates the charm of Chinese culture. The exhibition will use simple writings, images of artefacts and vivid illustrations to showcase the development and cultural connotations of Chinese characters.

The exhibition is also one of the activities in the Chinese Culture Promotion Series. The LCSD has long been promoting Chinese history and culture through organising an array of programmes and activities to enable the public to learn more about the broad and profound Chinese culture. For more information, please visit https://ccpo.gov.hk/en.

Jointly organised by Chinese Culture Promotion Office and National Museum of Chinese Writing

title: 《童唱歌劇》
description:
踏進魔幻森林，展開一趟奇幻歌劇之旅！

森林裡一個慵懶的下午怎樣化成一趟奇妙的歌劇旅程？在這場魔幻的音樂會裡，歌劇世界中的童話與名作將活現眼前。來自歌劇培訓工作坊的一眾年輕新星，將與專業歌劇演唱家同台獻技，攜手演繹取材自《卡門》、《魔笛》、《糖果屋》、《天皇》、《海盜王》及《魔法黑森林》的音樂故事。快來透過孩子們的眼睛，感受歌劇的懾人魅力！ Step into the Woods for a Magical Opera Adventure!

What happens when a sleepy afternoon in the woods turns into an enchanted opera journey? Join us for a spellbinding concert where opera’s fairy tales and masterpieces come to life. Young rising stars from our opera training workshops will take the stage side-by-side with professional opera singers for a whimsical performance of storytelling through “Carmen”, “The Magic Flute”, “Hansel and Gretel”, “The Mikado”, “The Pirates of Penzance”, and “Into the Woods”. Experience the magic of opera through the eyes of children!

title: 2026 香港青年音樂匯演 – 交響樂團匯演
title_en: 2026 Hong Kong Youth Music Interflows – Symphony Orchestra Interflow
description:
由音樂事務處主辦，香港青年音樂匯演每年11至12月期間舉行，通過中樂團、交響樂團、管樂團及弦樂團匯演交流，讓學校隊伍互相觀摩切磋樂藝。匯演邀請客席音樂家就參演隊伍的表現提供專業意見，以助提高同學的演奏水平。參演隊伍可獲頒獎項以資鼓勵。
 
交響樂團匯演分四組進行，包括小學A組、小學B組、中學A組及中學B組。今年有近60隊學校隊伍參加交響樂團匯演。
 
交響樂團匯演是2026年「青年節@HK」節目之一。

交響樂團匯演（小學組）每人每次限購2張門票。 Organised by the Music Office, the Hong Kong Youth Music Interflows is an annual inter-school event held in November and December. It facilitates mutual exchange among the Chinese orchestras, symphony orchestras, symphonic bands and string orchestras. The participating groups will receive comments from professional musicians. Awards are presented to participating groups for encouragement.
 
The Symphony Orchestra Interflow is arranged in 4 classes: Primary School Class A, Primary School Class B, Secondary School Class A and Secondary School Class B. Around 60 school orchestras will take part in the Symphony Orchestra Interflow this year.

The Symphony Orchestra Interflow is one of the programmes of the 2026 youthfest@HK.

Maximum 2 tickets per purchase per person for the Primary School Classes of Symphony Orchestra Interflow.

title: 亞藝無疆2026︰《聲之墨境》
description:
巴基斯坦裔視覺藝術家塔仙・奇恩在「阿迦汗音樂計劃」敘利亞裔演奏家費雷斯・查拉斯坦和巴素・拉祖神秘而豐富的音樂旋律中即興揮毫，將視覺藝術與音樂融為一體，共同構築這片令人神往的藝術之境。

塔仙・奇恩的書法融合阿拉伯、波斯和烏都語，三種語言出自同一書法源流，流麗的線條將中東古老新詮的音韻，化成看得見的即興律動。兩位音樂家穿梭於中東卡農琴的明亮音色、杜克拉管的獨特色彩，以及敲擊樂器的抒情旋律中，奏出悠然和諧的音樂。奇恩的筆觸隨之翩然舞動，描繪出「希望」、「仁愛」、「正義」與「和平」。每晚完成的書畫都是獨一無二，並於演出翌日公開展示。

《聲之墨境》由「阿迦汗音樂計劃」委約創作、構思及策劃，2024年12月於卡塔爾多哈國家博物館上演畫廊版本，舞台版演出在2025年愛丁堡國際藝術節上獲得熱烈好評。是次香港演出為舞台版的亞洲首演，誠邀觀眾放下煩囂，享受「聲」與「墨」交織的出塵境界，洗滌心靈。 Pakistani-born visual artist Tazeen Qayyum creates live, improvisatory calligraphic drawings against a serene yet luminous soundscape crafted by Syrian-born Aga Khan Master Musicians Feras Charestan and Basel Rajoub. This interdisciplinary performance featuring remarkable visuals gently weaves visual art and
music into a shared act of contemplation.

Watch as graceful strokes of Arabic, Persian and Urdu scripts — three languages united by a single calligraphic tradition — unfurl in response to the music, ancient melodic modes meeting contemporary improvisation. As the musicians move between the shimmering timbres of the qanun, the distinctive colour of the duclar, and the expressivity of soprano saxophone and percussion, Qayyum responds through four
guiding words: amal (hope), karam (kindness), adl (justice) and silm (peace). Each evening’s canvas is created in the moment, never to be repeated, and will be displayed the following day.

Commissioned, conceived and curated by Aga Khan Music Programme, the gallery edition of Canvas of Sound premiered in December 2024 at the National Museum of Qatar in Doha. Its stage edition received an overwhelming response at the 2025 Edinburgh International Festival, and now arrives in Hong Kong as its Asian première,
inviting you to slow down, look closely, and find a measure of inner peace.

title: 亞藝無疆2026︰阿薩德二重奏結他演奏會 - 結他大師班 （上午場）
title_en: Asia+ Festival 2026: "Guitar Duo Recital by Assad Brothers" - Guitar Masterclass  (AM Session)
description:
來自巴西的阿薩德二重奏縱橫結他樂壇逾半世紀，以高超技巧和非凡默契見稱，音樂糅合巴西民謠、拉丁、爵士和古典。

今次特設兩場結他大師班，分別邀請Sérgio同Odair即場親臨指導，分享精湛的演奏技巧與寶貴的藝術經驗。歡迎公眾人士到場旁聽，兩個場次近距離感受不同大師的非凡魅力。

英語講解

名額有限，先到先得 

8月31日傍晚時分開始登記 60 years at the top of the guitar world together, Sérgio and Odair Assad bring their anniversary world tour to Hong Kong with unrivalled virtuosity, where Brazilian folk, Latin, jazz and classical styles meet as one.

Two exclusive masterclasses will be held, respectively featuring Sérgio and Odair Assad. The maestros will provide hands-on coaching to students on stage, sharing their refined performance techniques and invaluable artistic experience. Members of the public are most welcome to join as observers to experience the respective maestros' remarkable artistry.

In English

Limited quota, on a first-come, first-served basis. 

Online registration starts from 31.8 evening

title: 亞藝無疆2026︰手集團《銅話鼓事》
title_en: Asia+ Festival 2026: "Taksu – The Spirit of Gamelan" by Hands Percussion
description:
馬來西亞頂尖敲擊樂團「手集團」攜手印尼峇里甘美蘭樂團呈獻《銅話鼓事》。
作品將中國獅鼓、氣勢磅礡的馬來西亞二十四節令鼓，與飄逸靈性的甘美蘭音樂
完美融合，在冷冽金屬與溫熱鼓皮的對比中，共譜一場跨越疆界的對話。

「甘美蘭」起源自千年前的爪哇和峇里的宮廷和寺院，被視為世界音樂的寶藏。
演出中逾三十組最具代表性的甘美蘭金屬片琴、銅鑼與鼓組，與獅鼓和節令鼓交
織共振，融入傳統瑪蓉舞與歌曲，將經典昇華為當代「甘美蘭劇場」。銅音清透
優雅，鼓皮之聲雄渾，在強烈對比中，探索峇里文化中「Taksu」點燃藝術熱情、
直指人心的神聖能量。香港場更特別邀得香港兒童合唱團獻聲，詮釋以甘美蘭改
編、家傳戶曉的中國民歌《茉莉花》。

拋開都市繁囂，讓原始樂音帶你尋回久違的生命力與心靈共鳴。 Malaysia’s celebrated Hands Percussion brings a rare cross-cultural dialogue to Hong
Kong, where the thunderous pulse of Chinese shigu (lion dance drums) meets the
sonorous, sweetly flowing resonance of Balinese and Malay gamelan percussion,
weaving the coolness of metal and the warmth of drum skin.

Widely regarded as one of the world’s musical treasures, gamelan was born in the
royal courts and temples of Java and Bali over a thousand years ago. More than
thirty sets of gamelan instruments, from shimmering bronze metallophones and
gongs, to the Malaysian 24 Festive Drums rooted in Chinese drumming tradition,
integrating with graceful Mak Yong dance and music, come together to reinvent
gamelan into contemporary theatre. The striking contrast of bronze and animal skin
evokes Taksu, an ancient Balinese belief in a sacred inner force that transforms art
into something felt deep within the soul. For this special Hong Kong occasion, The
Hong Kong Children’s Choir lends their voices to a gamelan reimagining of Jasmine
Flower, one of the most beloved Chinese folk songs.

Leave behind the city’s hustle and bustle, and let the music help you rediscover the
vitality you have long missed.

title: 亞藝無疆2026︰眉月製作《圓》
title_en: Asia+ Festival 2026: "Teh Dar" by Lune Production
description:
當代馬戲劇場《圓》帶領觀眾走進越南中部雲霧繚繞的高原深處，感受生機勃發的古老文化。

「Teh Dar」在西原格賀族的語言中意為「繞圈而行」，寓意生生不息。紅色舞台象徵西原的紅土地貌，雜技演員在千變萬化的竹藝結構上表演高空驚險技藝。先祖的神話在密林間流傳，千年不滅的營火，點燃壯闊山巒之魂，一一呈現觀眾眼前。現場樂隊以鑼鉦、水牛角、竹琴和象腳鼓等傳統樂器，演奏被列為聯合國非物質文
化遺產的西原鑼鉦文化。

《圓》神秘而充滿力量，歌頌經過時間洗練，依然歷久常新的傳統文化。眉月製作素有「越南版太陽馬戲團」的美譽，此作品於歐洲巡演後現首度登上香港舞台，不容錯過。 Deep in the mist-shrouded highlands of Vietnam, ancient traditions pulse with vitality. Teh Dar is a celebration of mountain culture and wild beauty in the form of contemporary acrobatic theatre.

In the K’Ho language, “Teh Dar” means “going in circles”, evoking the eternal cycle of life. On a stage reminiscent of the region’s distinctive red soil landscape, acrobatic
performers conjure scenes of ancestral legend through daring aerial feats on evolving bamboo structures. Stories once sung deep within forests, echoed across soaring heights, and whispered around fires for generations now unfold vividly on stage. A live ensemble plays traditional instruments including gong, buffalo horn, T’rung and long drum, rooted in the Gong Culture of these highland communities, a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity.

Enigmatic, explosive and visceral, Teh Dar is a testament to humanity that continues to shine brightly across centuries. Widely acclaimed as “Vietnam’s Cirque du Soleil”,
Lune Production now arrives in Hong Kong with Teh Dar after a successful European
tour. A truly unmissable experience.

Stories once sung deep within forests, echoed across soaring heights, and whispered around fires for generations now unfold vividly on stage. A live ensemble plays traditional instruments including gong, buffalo horn, T’rung and long drum, rooted in the Gong Culture of these highland communities, a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity.

Enigmatic, explosive and visceral, Teh Dar is a testament to humanity that continues to shine brightly across centuries. Widely acclaimed as “Vietnam’s Cirque du Soleil”,
Lune Production now arrives in Hong Kong with Teh Dar after a successful European
tour. A truly unmissable experience.

title: 亞藝無疆2026︰《阿薩德二重奏結他演奏會》
title_en: Asia+ Festival 2026: Guitar Duo Recital by Assad Brothers
description:
來自巴西的阿薩德二重奏縱橫古典結他樂壇逾半世紀，以高超技巧和非凡默契見稱。2026年適逢兄弟合作六十周年及中巴文化年，來港獻技以饗樂迷。

阿薩德二重奏的音樂糅合巴西民謠、拉丁、爵士和古典，獲多個拉丁格林美及格林美獎項肯定。他們曾合作的一流藝術家不計其數，除了與馬友友、甘祈頓和洛杉磯愛樂樂團等合作之外，阿根廷傳奇作曲家皮亞梭拉亦曾專門為他們譜曲。

今次演出作品涵蓋他們歷來最為樂迷津津樂道的曲目，包括皮亞梭拉的迷人探戈、巴西史上最偉大作曲家魏拉-羅伯斯筆下的本土風情和沙治奧・阿薩德的原創作品，更有在香港鮮有演出的巴西特色旋律。本地古箏演奏家萬幸將與大師合奏一首以花木蘭為靈感的全新樂曲，作為送給香港樂迷的特別禮物。 Sixty years at the top of the guitar world together, Sérgio and Odair Assad bring their
anniversary world tour to Hong Kong for an evening of unrivalled virtuosity and telepathic unity, where Brazilian folk, Latin, jazz and classical styles meet as one.

Winners of multiple Grammy and Latin Grammy Awards, the Brazilian masters have
collaborated with the greatest names in classical music, including Yo-Yo Ma, Gidon
Kremer and the Los Angeles Philharmonic. Astor Piazzolla, renowned as “father of
new tango”, wrote works for them. The programme brings together their most iconic
repertoire, from Piazzolla’s mesmerising tango and Villa-Lobos’ Brazilian soul to
Sérgio Assad’s own celebrated compositions, alongside Brazilian treasures rarely
heard in Hong Kong. Local guzheng player Wan Xing joins in a special piece
inspired by the legend of Mulan, in celebration of China-Brazil Cultural Year
in 2026.

title: 中國內地電影展 2026
description:
自1997年起，中國內地電影展已歷經廿九年寒暑，每一年記錄着時代的脈動，更見證着一代代電影人的萌芽與綻放。

我們深信，所有震撼人心的銀幕史詩，都始於最初那幾秒不甘平庸的閃念。今年我們將以「短片啟航，長片盛放」為題，完整呈現內地導演「從零到一」的創作心路，本屆影展特別加推「長短片單元」，冀令觀眾能親眼目睹創作者們千里之行始於足下的破局軌跡，鏡頭後摸索最初的熾熱與悸動。

開幕電影《浪浪山小妖怪》，由爆紅短片《中國奇譚之小妖怪的夏天》延伸而來，幾隻無名小妖組成「西天取經團」，踏上一場笑中有淚的冒險，道盡職場草根的生存法則與韌性；《火鍋英雄》延續導演楊慶在大學戲劇作業中的密閉空間敘事方式，引爆一場夾雜兄弟情、舊日戀情和黑幫衝突的荒誕風暴；黑色犯罪喜劇《受益人》展現了導演申奧從拍攝多套短片累積的扎實功力，用荒誕騙局勾勒底層人物的困頓與溫情；聚焦京劇少年變聲困惑的《倒倉》，從 15 分鐘短片發酵，折射出青春期關於性別認同與對未來的徬徨。

奇幻大作《從21世紀安全撤離》延續導演李陽一貫以來富視覺衝擊的風格，用遊戲化敘事勾勒一場永不結束的夏日大冒險；藏族女導演崗珍作品《一個夜晚與三個夏天》以現代拉薩的年輕視角，鋪陳一段關於記憶與成長的微妙蛻變。獲得國際影展肯定的《喜喪》，從同名短片深耕演化，以沉鬱的紀實力量直視農村老齡化與傳統孝道的巨大鴻溝。

《老槍》則將視線拉回80年代廠區，看退役神槍手如何在時代陣痛中迎來終極爆發；《蒼山》由 28 分鐘短片擴展而來，細膩呈現中年女性離鄉打工，在物是人非的環境下追尋心靈自由的時代鄉愁；口碑極佳，二維原創國產動畫標桿的《羅小黑戰記II》，延續了前作標誌性的清新治癒畫風與冷幽默，開啟了新一段充滿未知與危機的冒險之旅。

原為廣州美術學院的學生畢業短片《落凡塵》，經超過二千名動畫師的努力，嶄新的國風設計配合視覺特技，把「牛郎織女」的延伸故事構建成蕩氣迴腸的動畫大片；更有創下票房奇蹟，從備受讚譽的舞台小品蛻變為感人至深的喜劇長片《你好，李煥英》。

期望透過是次展映，向香港觀眾展現內地電影工作者最原汁原味的創作軌跡，也為兩地電影人搭建一座能彼此對話、煥發光影的舞台。 Since 1997, the Chinese Mainland Film Panorama has spanned 29 years, capturing the pulse of changing times while witnessing generations of filmmakers take root and flourish.

Every great film begins with a spark of imagination. This year, under the theme “The Journey from Shorts to Features”, we spotlight Mainland filmmakers and their creative paths, with a special section tracing their journey from early short experiments to feature films.

Opening film Nobody is an extension of the hit short of the same title from the Yao-Chinese Folktales. It follows a group of nameless little monsters on a humorous yet touching adventure that reflects the struggles and resilience of ordinary workers. Chongqing Hot Pot captures the essence of a confined-space setting that originated as a university assignment, while black comedy My Dear Liar reflects director Shen Ao’s experience gained through short film making. The Midsummer’s Voice, expanded from a 15-minute short about a young Peking Opera performer’s changing voice, explores adolescence, identity and uncertainty about the future.

Escape from the 21st Century continues director Li Yang’s visually dynamic style through a game-like summer adventure. Set in Lhasa, Linka Linka offers a young perspective on memory and growing up. Internationally acclaimed Laughing to Die, developed from a short film of the same name, confronts rural ageing and traditional filial piety.

A Long Shot returns to a factory community in the 1980s, following a retired sharpshooter caught in a changing era. Expanded from a 28-minute short, Like Winds, Like Weeds portrays a middle-aged woman searching for freedom away from home. The highly acclaimed Chinese animated feature The Legend of Hei II builds on its popular predecessor with its signature fresh, soothing visuals and dry humour, sending its characters on a new adventure filled with uncertainty and danger.

Originally a graduation short film from the Guangzhou Academy of Fine Arts, Into the Mortal World was developed by over 2,000 animators into a visually striking feature inspired by the tale of The Cowherd and the Weaver Girl. Hi, Mom evolved from an acclaimed comedy sketch into a heartfelt feature and box-office phenomenon.

Through this film festival, we hope to showcase the creative voices of Chinese Mainland filmmakers to Hong Kong audiences, while creating a platform for filmmakers from both sides to connect, exchange ideas and inspire one another.

A Long Shot returns to a factory community in the 1980s, following a retired sharpshooter caught in a changing era. Expanded from a 28-minute short, Like Winds, Like Weeds portrays a middle-aged woman searching for freedom away from home. The highly acclaimed Chinese animated feature The Legend of Hei II builds on its popular predecessor with its signature fresh, soothing visuals and dry humour, sending its characters on a new adventure filled with uncertainty and danger.

Screenwriters: Gao Peng, Wang Ang, Wang Wen, Fang Chang
Cinematographer: Florian J.E. Zinke BVK
Cast: Zu Feng, Qin Hailu, Zhou Zhengjie

In 1980s northeastern China, local factories were struggling, and stealing was everywhere. A former shooter, now working as a factory guard, finds out his colleagues are helping the thieves. Upset but unable to stop them, he hides his anger—until the son of the woman he loves gets dragged into the crime. Driven to his limit, he is finally forced to pick up his gun again.

Director Gao Peng first distinguished himself with the thriller short The Scar (33′) from Disturbed Souls on Campus, showing his great skill at building suspense. He brings that same strength to his first feature-length film, A Long Shot, keeping his steady storytelling style and unique visuals.

title: 中國內地電影展 2026：《火鍋英雄》
title_en: Chinese Mainland Film Panorama 2026: "Chongqing Hot Pot"
description:
導演、編劇：楊慶
攝影：廖擬
主演：陳坤、白百何、秦昊、喻恩泰
出品：新麗傳媒股份有限公司、工夫影業股份有限公司、萬達影視傳媒有限公司
2016 | 彩色 | 98′
普通話、重慶方言對白，中英文字幕

在滿布防空洞的重慶，三個好兄弟合夥開的麻辣火鍋店快倒閉了。為了賣個好價錢，他們動手挖地擴建，沒想到竟挖穿了銀行金庫。成堆現金就在眼前，窮途末路的三人陷入劇烈掙扎。一場夾雜着兄弟情、舊日戀情和黑幫衝突的荒誕風暴隨之引爆。

本片延續導演楊慶大學時期戲劇作業《夜襲超市》的密閉空間敘事方式，這次將舞台搬進火鍋防空洞，以更成熟及扎實的手法，呈現出近年內地電影裏少見的類型片風格。 Director & Screenwriter: Yang Qing
Cinematographer: Liao Ni
Cast: Chen Kun, Bai Baihe, Qin Hao, Yu Entai
Produced by New Classics Media, CKF Pictures, Wanda Media Co., Ltd.
2016 | Colour | 98′
In Putonghua and Chongqing dialect with Chinese and English subtitles

In Chongqing, a city filled with air-raid shelters, three buddies are about to lose their hotpot restaurant. They dig to expand it for a higher price, but accidentally break into a bank vault. Staring at piles of cash, they are caught in a difficult dilemma, setting off an absurd chain of events involving brotherhood, lost romance and gang conflict.

The film continues the confined-space storytelling of director Yang Qing’s university short-film assignment, this time setting the stage in a hotpot bunker. With greater maturity and confidence, Yang delivers a stylised genre film rarely seen in recent Mainland Chinese cinema.

title: 中國內地電影展 2026：《從21世紀安全撤離》
title_en: Chinese Mainland Film Panorama 2026: "Escape from the 21st Century"
description:
導演、編劇：李陽
攝影：Saba Mazloum
主演：張若昀、鍾楚曦、宋洋、吳曉亮
出品：北京申城國際影視有限公司、北京光線影業有限公司、北京歡喜首映文化有限公司
2024 | 彩色 | 98′
普通話對白，中英文字幕

第27屆上海國際電影節「電影頻道傳媒關注單元」最受傳媒關注新人導演
第20屆中國長春電影節金鹿獎最佳處女作獎

三位高中生在機緣巧合下擁有了往返未來的超能力，譜寫了一個關於戰鬥、熱血與兄弟情的故事。這部作品最亮眼的突破，在於以琳瑯滿目的視覺風格敘事——打個噴嚏就能穿梭二十年時空，秒變動畫的打鬥場面，導演以各式的風格混搭起主角們天真爛漫的中二病。主角們擁有的三種性格缺陷：抗拒成長、逞強硬撐，以及在模仿他人中迷失自我，令人看畢後有所自省。

回溯導演李陽的創作軌跡，從《李獻計歷險記》的動畫驚艷，到《壞未來》的短片試驗，再到如今這部《從21世紀安全撤離》，始終貫穿着強烈的視覺衝擊力、情緒感染力與意象化表達。

設映後談 (粵語主講)
17. 10. 2026 (六)
香港電影資料館電影院
講者：楊寶文

映後談座位有限，持映後談電影放映門票的觀眾優先入座，其餘座位先到先得。觀眾可於映後談開始前15分鐘於香港電影資料館1樓大堂等候入座。 Director & Screenwriter: Li Yang
Cinematographer: Saba Mazloum
Cast: Zhang Ruoyun, Zhong Chuxi, Song Yang, Wu Xiaoliang
Produced by Beijing Scity Films Co., Ltd., Beijing Enlight Pictures Co., Ltd., Huanxi Media Group Limited (Beijing)
2024 | Colour | 98′
In Putonghua with Chinese and English subtitles

New Director of Media Focus, China Movie Channel Media Focus Unit, The 27th Shanghai International Film Festival
Best Debut Film, Golden Deer Awards, The 20th China Changchun Film Festival

Three high school students gain the power of time travel, embarking on an adventure of action, passion and brotherhood. The film stands out for its dazzling visual styles—a sneeze sends them twenty years forward, while fight scenes suddenly burst into animation, vividly capturing their wild adolescent imagination. Each character embodies a familiar struggle of growing up: resisting maturity, hiding vulnerability, or losing identity through imitation—mirrors everyone.

Director Li Yang’s signature blend of striking visuals, emotional intensity, and imaginative storytelling runs throughout his work, from Lee’s Adventures and the short Bad Future to his latest, Escape from the 21st Century. 

Post-screening Talk (In Cantonese)
17. 10. 2026 (Sat)
Cinema, Hong Kong Film Archive
Speaker: Polly Yeung

Limited Seats available for post-screening talk. Ticket holders of the screening with post-screening talk will be admitted with priority. Remaining seats will be opened on a first-come, first-served basis. Audiences are welcome to queue up at 1/F, Hong Kong Film Archive 15 minutes before the talk begins.

description:
導演：鍾鼎
編劇：康夫

出品：廣東詠聲動漫股份有限公司、嗶哩嗶哩影業（天津）有限公司、北京阿里巴巴影業文化有限公司
2024 | 彩色 | 118′
粵語配音，中英文字幕

同場加映短片

《落凡塵》取材於中國四大民間傳說——「牛郎織女」，圍繞牛郎織女後代冒險的故事，並首次將二十八星宿的神話元素搬上大銀幕，還進行了「牛郎織女」神話故事拓展。織女後人金風下凡，與失散多年的妹妹玉露（小凡）結盟，攜手開啟神界之間冒險的故事，突顯出親情的主題。

本片原是2020年廣州美術學院的學生畢業短片同名作品《落凡塵》(7′)，經過超過二千名動畫藝術家的努力，耗時五年完成，是內地首部從本科院校畢業作品孵化成商業院線電影的作品。

除星光大道梳士巴利花園草地場次外，其他免費放映場次須憑票入場。門票將在東九文化中心詢問處於10月16日上午10時起派發。每人限取每場門票兩張，先到先得，派完即止。

節目或會因惡劣天氣而取消或作出調動。請於活動開始前三小時，留意「電影節目辦事處」網頁公布的最新安排。 Director: Zhong Ding
Screenwriter: Kang Fu
Dubbing: Xie Jiajun, Chen Yinghui, Chan Yan, Huang Zhi-cong, Cheng Lai Lai
Produced by Guangdong Winsing Company Limited, Bilibili, Alibaba Pictures (Beijing) Co., Ltd.
2024 | Colour | 118′
In Cantonese with Chinese and English subtitles

Short Film after the Feature

Not only is Into the Mortal World the first film to take the mythological elements of the 28 Constellation Mansions to the big screen, it’s also a re-interpretation of the famous The Cowherd and the Weaver Girl mythology. This iteration tells the story of Jinfeng, a descendent of the Weaver Girl who forms a “constellation collecting” alliance with her long-lost sister Yulu (Xiaofan). Together, they embark on an adventure that also highlights the theme of family affection.

The film originally began as a same-title graduation short film, Into the Mortal World (7′), of Guangzhou Academy of Fine Arts (GAFA) in 2020. Thanks to the hard work of over 2,000 animation artists over 5 years, the film became the first GAFA graduation film to become a commercial feature film.

Free Admission with ticket except for the Salisbury Garden screening. Free admission tickets will be distributed at Information Counter at East Kowloon Cultural Centre starting from 10am on 16 October. Each person can obtain up to two tickets per screening on a first-come, first-served basis.

Programmes may be cancelled or adjusted due to adverse weather. Please check the latest arrangements for programme on the website of Film Programmes Office at least three hours before the start of the programmes.

title_en: Chinese Mainland Film Panorama 2026: "Laughing to Die"
description:
導演、編劇：張濤
攝影：武卓、諶翔
主演：郁鳳雲、王士蘭、李寶明
出品：不同映像影業（北京）有限公司、華策影業（天津）有限公司
2015 | 彩色 | 108′
普通話對白，中英文字幕

同場加映短片

第10屆FIRST青年電影展最佳劇情片、最佳導演
第70屆康城影展ACID單元入選影片

當血濃於水的長者變成家庭重擔，親情還能承受多少現實的磨蝕？導演張濤以冷靜克制的鏡頭，凝視一位農村獨居老人的晚年，透視城鄉變遷下逐漸鬆動的家庭倫理。全片由非職業演員出演，沒有誇張的狗血衝突劇情，只有近乎紀錄片般的真實細節，平靜地撕開傳統孝道的外殼，是一部關於衰老、尊嚴與責任的沉痛作品。

該片由同名短片《喜喪》(30′)延伸而來，用精簡的篇幅營造老人晚年困境的氛圍；長片則加入更豐富的生活細節與更複雜的人物描寫，讓每個子女的無奈與私心都呈現得更加立體。透過紀實深化，電影的層次感與現實重量被發揮到了極致。 Director & Screenwriter: Zhang Tao
Cinematographers: Wu Zhuo, Chen Xiang
Cast: Yu Fengyun, Wang Shilan, Li Baoming
Produced by Different Imaging Film Industry (Beijing) Co., Ltd., Huace Film (Tianjin) Co., Ltd.
2015 | Colour | 108′
In Putonghua with Chinese and English subtitles

Short Film after the Feature

Best Narrative Feature, Best Director, The 10th FIRST International Film Festival
Official Selection, ACID, The 70th Cannes Film Festival

When old age becomes a burden, how much pressure can family love survive? Director Zhang Tao calmly looks at the final years of an elderly woman living alone in a rural village. The film shows how traditional family values are disappearing as the country changes. Performed entirely by non-professional actors, the film exposes the painful realities of conflicts. It is a story about growing old, dignity, and duty.

The feature grew out of Zhang Tao’s short film of the same name, Laughing to Die (30′). While the short film quickly shows the loneliness of old age, the feature adds more everyday details. It takes a deeper look at the helpless and selfish of younger generation. Moving from a short film to a feature makes the story feel even more real and powerful.

婚姻失意的中年女性，逃離過往，遠赴上海當家務助理，邊打工邊照顧失智母親和叛逆兒子。城市繁華背後，三人無時無刻不想回鄉，但當終於重返故鄉蒼山，等待他們的卻已物是人非，連故鄉的名字也更改了，鄉愁也無法落葉歸根。一段祖孫三人在異鄉的生存故事，一趟追尋心靈自由的艱難旅程。

導演張帆從同名短片《蒼山》(28′)中積累經驗，將長片延伸為深刻的女性困境與時代鄉愁。影片在多個影展榮獲好評，獻給每一個離鄉者。 Director: Zhang Fan
Screenwriters: Zhang Fan, Wang Yingjie
Cinematographer: Li Yong
Cast: Guo Keyu, Wang Shiyun, Chen Jiayang, Liu Guihong, Cao Yumei
Produced by Lynn & Fan Pictures, Zhong Film Production

Short Film after the Feature

Best Picture Nomination, Golden Coconut Awards, The 5th Hainan Island International Film Festival
Best Narrative Feature Nomination, The 17th FIRST International Film Festival

Following a marriage failure, a middle-aged woman moves to Shanghai and works as a housekeeper. At the same time, she looks after her mother with dementia and her rebellious son. Beneath the city’s glittering surface, all three long to return home. Yet upon returning to their hometown beneath Cangshan Mountain, they find everything has changed—even the place they once called home, now bears a different name. A story of three generations struggling to survive away from home, Like Winds, Like Weeds is a tough journey in search of inner freedom.

Director Zhang Fan expands the short film of the same name, Like Winds, Like Weeds (28′), into a feature-length exploration of the struggles faced by women, nostalgia and displacement. Acclaimed at several film festivals, the film is dedicated to everyone who has ever left home.

婚姻失意的中年女性，逃離過往，遠赴上海當家務助理，邊打工邊照顧失智母親和叛逆兒子。城市繁華背後，三人無時無刻不想回鄉，但當終於重返故鄉蒼山，等待他們的卻已物是人非，連故鄉的名字也更改了，鄉愁也無法落葉歸根。一段祖孫三人在異鄉的生存故事，一趟追尋心靈自由的艱難旅程。

導演張帆從同名短片《蒼山》(28′)中積累經驗，將長片延伸為深刻的女性困境與時代鄉愁。影片在多個影展榮獲好評，獻給每一個離鄉者。 Director: Zhang Fan
Screenwriters: Zhang Fan, Wang Yingjie
Cinematographer: Li Yong
Cast: Guo Keyu, Wang Shiyun, Chen Jiayang, Liu Guihong, Cao Yumei
Produced by Lynn & Fan Pictures, Zhong Film Production
2023 | Colour | 109′
In Putonghua with Chinese and English subtitles

Short Film after the Feature

Best Picture Nomination, Golden Coconut Awards, The 5th Hainan Island International Film Festival
Best Narrative Feature Nomination, The 17th FIRST International Film Festival

Following a marriage failure, a middle-aged woman moves to Shanghai and works as a housekeeper. At the same time, she looks after her mother with dementia and her rebellious son. Beneath the city’s glittering surface, all three long to return home. Yet upon returning to their hometown beneath Cangshan Mountain, they find everything has changed—even the place they once called home, now bears a different name. A story of three generations struggling to survive away from home, Like Winds, Like Weeds is a tough journey in search of inner freedom.

Director Zhang Fan expands the short film of the same name, Like Winds, Like Weeds (28′), into a feature-length exploration of the struggles faced by women, nostalgia and displacement. Acclaimed at several film festivals, the film is dedicated to everyone who has ever left home.

「受益人」為保險行業的常用詞，電影以荒誕的「殺妻騙保」為主線，將網絡直播生態、騙保犯罪及底層生存困境交織成一個犯罪喜劇故事。影片善用重慶方言及山城空間去貼近小人物的生活，平添幾分黑色幽默。

Named from the insurance term “beneficiary”, the film follows a husband who plots to kill his wife for an insurance payout. Blending livestreaming, insurance fraud, and the struggles of the underclass, this dark comedy unfolds. Set against Chongqing’s mountainous landscape and spoken in the local dialect, the film roots its fraud plot in everyday life with a touch of absurdity.

Director Shen Ao first made his mark through his graduation short film, The Opposite Shore, which won international awards and showcased his solid audiovisual craftsmanship. His technical skills caught the eye of Ning Hao, producer of Dying to Survive, which ultimately led to the creation of this feature film.

普通話配音，中英文字幕

第22屆中國國際動漫節「金猴獎」綜合獎動畫電影金獎

貓妖羅小黑與師父無限在村莊裏過着安寧的生活，他也逐漸適應了人類世界的日常。然而，流石會館突遭襲擊，兩人平靜的生活瞬間被打破，無限更慘遭陷害。為洗清師父的冤屈，小黑毅然與師姐鹿野踏上旅程，在一場充滿未知與危機的破案之旅中，追尋人妖能否共存的答案。

原版網絡動畫於2011年開播，每集僅5分鐘，細膩描繪小黑與人類女孩的溫馨日常，風格療癒。電影版在動作場面與敘事節奏上全面升級，是國漫系列內絕不能錯過的頂級視覺盛宴！ Director: MTJJ, Gu Jie
Screenwriters: MTJJ, Gu Jie, Peng Kexin, Fengxishenlei
Dubbing: Shan Xin, Zhu Jing, Liu Mingyue, Luan Lisheng
Produced by Beijing Qianwanjian Culture Communication Co., Ltd., Beijing HMCH Anime Co., Ltd., COL Group Co., Ltd.
2025 | Colour | 119′
In Putonghua with Chinese and English subtitles

Gold Prize, General Awards – Animated Feature Film, Golden Monkey King Awards, The 22nd China International Cartoon & Animation Festival

Cat spirit Luo Xiaohei lives a peaceful life in a village with his master, Wuxian, gradually adapting to the human world. Their peace is shattered when the Liushi Guild Hall is attacked and Wuxian is framed. To defend his master, Xiaohei sets out with his senior disciple sister on a dangerous journey, exploring how humans and spirits can coexist.

The original 2011 web series featured healing, five-minute episodes about Xiaohei’s heartwarming daily life with a human girl. The film elevates the action and pacing, delivering a spectacular visual feast you cannot miss in Chinese animation.

同場加映短片

第26屆上海國際電影節「一帶一路電影周」最受觀眾喜愛影片
第37屆中國電影金雞獎最佳導演處女作獎
第18屆FIRST青年電影展最佳編劇

「倒倉」，本是戲曲少年在變聲期經歷的特殊生理現象，期間嗓音或變低或變啞。戲台上，少年最怕「倒倉」；戲台外，他們怕迷失自我。本片講述了三個京劇少年，在漫長暑假中，各自面對青春期的恐懼、性別認同的困惑，以及未來道路的彷徨。大家的心結各有不同，卻都在跌撞中覺醒。

從15分鐘同名短片《倒倉》驚艷亮相，長片劇情在短片基礎上更扎實更豐富，新晉導演張裕笛以新鮮視角賦予了傳統戲曲前所未有的生命力，在青春與傳統之間，找到最動人的共振。 Director: Zhang Yudi
Screenwriters: Huo Xueying, Zhang Yudi
Cinematographer: Yan Yu
Cast: Bian Cheng, Zhou Meijun, Zhang Chi, Chen Shaoxi, Xu Shixin
Produced by Maxtimes (Hubei) Co., Ltd., Hubei Yangtze River Film Group Co., Ltd., Hubei Media Group
2024 | Colour | 102′
In Putonghua with Chinese and English subtitles

Short Film after the Feature

Audience Choice Award, The Belt and Road Film Week, The 26th Shanghai International Film Festival
Best Directorial Debut, The 37th China Golden Rooster Awards
Best Screenplay, The 18th FIRST International Film Festival

In Chinese opera, “Dao Cang” refers to a unique challenge when a young performer’s voice changes, becoming deeper, rougher, or hoarse. On stage, it is what performers fear most; off stage, they fear losing who they are. The film follows three young Peking Opera performers over one summer. As they deal with growing up, identity struggles, and fear of the future, they learn to understand themselves through these hard times.

Expanding from the 15-minute short The Midsummer’s Voice, the feature builds a richer story. Director Zhang Yudi brings a fresh perspective to traditional opera, giving new life to the art form and finding a touching link between youth and tradition.

title: 古典音樂講座系列：《音樂．心處》
title_en: Classical Music Lecture Series: "Music at Heart"
description:
古典音樂世界從不乏個性鮮明的大師，他們的喜怒哀樂、人生際遇與奇思妙想，不僅見於軼聞，更流露於作品與演繹之中。

《音樂．心處》由聆聽出發，從八個主題切入，帶您走進大師們曾面對的處境與心境，細味多段精選錄音及錄像，體會經典名曲何以跨越時代，至今仍能觸動人心。

策劃／講者：賴建群



2026年10月7日（三）
第一集：率性與狂熱
莫扎特在《音樂玩笑》中，把業餘樂手最忌諱的走音失拍，化作討喜的笑料；李斯特則在《創世六日》變奏曲中，聯同另外五位頂尖鋼琴家同台競技，盡展一代鋼琴之王睥睨群雄的豪情與燦爛技藝。至於白遼士，更將對女演員的瘋狂單戀，昇華為《幻想交響曲》中澎湃迷幻的樂章。讓我們細味大師們率真灑脫的一面。

第二集：心靈風暴

7 Oct 2026 (Wed)
Episode 1: Untamed Spirits

18 Nov 2026 (Wed)

25 Nov 2026 (Wed)
Episode 8: Modern Musical Imagination
Since the 20th century, the boundaries of music have been continually redefined.  Russian composer Scriabin sought to connect sound with colour and spiritual imagination.  American composer George Gershwin and Argentine composer Astor Piazzolla each brought jazz and tango into dialogue with classical music.  John Cage placed environmental sounds at the centre of listening through 4′33″, while Ligeti created a gradually dissolving soundscape from the interwoven sounds of one hundred metronomes.  Join us to explore the boundless possibilities of music.

description: 本計劃以傳統客家女性的「四頭四尾」 — 田頭地尾（務農）、灶頭鑊尾（做飯）、針頭線尾（縫紉）和家頭教尾（持家教子）為切入點，藉由「編織」這個意象，將勞動記憶與情感敘事緊密串連，藉此喚起大眾對傳統客家女性的認識，構建跨代的文化對話空間。舞劇以客家童謠《月光光》為引子，將當代描寫客家女性的詩作與現代舞融合，營造萬家燈火中充滿詩意的故事。 This project explores the traditional roles of Hakka women known as "Four Heads and Four Ends": "field head and land end" (farming), "stove head and pot end" (cooking), "needle head and thread end" (sewing), and "home head and teaching end" (household and child-rearing).  Through the imagery of "weaving", it links memories of labour with emotional narratives to raise community awareness of Hakka women and creates an opportunity for inter-generational cultural dialogue.  Drawing inspiration from the Hakka nursery rhyme Moonlight contemporary poetry on Hakka women with modern dance, the dance theatre blends to unfold a poetic story against the myriad lights of homes.​

title: 2026社區文化大使: 匯樂團「古典亦時尚」社區音樂會
title_en: Community Cultural Ambassador 2026: Music Assembly 'Classic Vogue' Community Concert
description: 在歐洲古典音樂的發展史中，不乏借鑒民間及東方音樂而創作的偉大作品，本計劃以不同時期古典作曲家的創作風格為靈感，融合中國傳統及現代音樂元素，由結合了歐洲古典樂器、中國傳統樂器及現代電子樂器的樂團，透過此融合音樂節目，在社區推廣香港原創音樂的品牌形象。 The history of European classical music includes many great works that incorporates folk and Eastern musical elements.  This project draws inspiration from the compositional styles of different periods, fusing traditional Chinese and contemporary elements to create a crossover programme for an ensemble that blends European classical instruments, traditional Chinese instruments, and modern electronic instruments, promoting Hong Kong's original music brand throughout the community.

description: 計劃融合非物質文化遺產、共融藝術及海洋環保三大主題，透過一系列的活動推廣本地文化，讓大眾親身體驗粵劇藝術，提升對傳統表演藝術和本地歷史的認識，並打造以粵劇、木偶戲與皮影戲元素的共融舞台，為觀眾帶來具創意及文化深度的藝術體驗。 The project integrates three vibrant themes: intangible cultural heritage, inclusive arts, and marine conservation. title: 2026社區文化大使: 東方琴韻藝術團「聽見非遺」華夏正聲 非遺音樂匯萃
title_en: Community Cultural Ambassador 2026: Rhythmic East Arts Group 'The Echo of Intangible Cultural Heritage' Ancient Voice of China: ICH Music Collection
description: 中國古代多次出現中原人士南遷的社會現象，使中原音樂得以傳播至嶺南一帶，並與當地不同風俗與文化融合，孕育出瑰麗多姿的音樂系譜。上世紀中葉的香港接納不同地區的移民在此落地生根，使這座城市成為承載著多元歷史與文化記憶的開放社會，至今仍保存著眾多非物質文化遺產。本計劃將以非遺音樂為主題，在社區展開巡演，旨在承傳、活化與推廣列入香港非物質文化遺產清單的非遺音樂。 In ancient China, repeated southward migrations of people from the Central Plains facilitated the spread of Central Plains music to the Lingnan region, where it merged with local customs and cultures to form a splendid musical lineage.  In the mid-twentieth century, Hong Kong welcomed immigrants from various regions to settle and take root, becoming an open city that bears diverse historical and cultural memories and preserves numerous items of intangible cultural heritage to this day.  This project presents a community tour themed on Intangible Cultural Heritage music to inherit, revitalise, and promote musical items listed on the Hong Kong Intangible Cultural Heritage Inventory.​

This project presents a community tour themed on Intangible Cultural Heritage music to inherit, revitalise, and promote musical items listed on the Hong Kong Intangible Cultural Heritage Inventory.​

title: 2026社區文化大使: 香港非洲藝術文化協會「節拍部落」互動鼓舞巡演
title_en: Community Cultural Ambassador 2026: Sankofa Hong Kong African Arts and Culture Association 'The Rhythm Tribe' Interactive Drumming and Dance Performance
description: 「節拍部落」邀請你踏上一場獨特的遊牧旅程，感受節拍的力量與西非音樂的魅力。置身於這個充滿活力的部落中，讓環保藝術與深厚的文化氛圍交織，點燃每個人的創意火花。我們歡迎你化身村民，通過鼓樂和舞蹈，全心全意地分享喜悅和表達自我。 The Rhythm Tribe invites you on a nomadic journey to experience the power of rhythm and the charm of West African music.  This vibrant community sparks creativity through recycled arts and a rich cultural atmosphere.  We welcome you to join as villagers to share joy and express yourselves wholeheartedly through drumming and dance.

title: 2026社區文化大使—人木「《止戈為武》合家歡音樂劇」巡迴演出
title_en: Community Cultural Ambassador 2026: The People's Theatre "Family Musical 'The True Martial Way'" Touring Performances
description: 《止戈為武》是一部融合中華武術和美妙樂韻的原創合家歡音樂劇。演出以「以武入樂，以樂全心」為核心思想，透過動人的旋律、震撼的武打場面和溫馨幽默的劇情，傳遞「以武止戈、以和為貴」的傳統智慧。劇中武術剛柔並濟，巧妙結合音樂與舞蹈，呈現力量與慈悲兩種理念的平衡；音樂創作則融匯國樂精髓與現代編曲，既有激昂的武打配樂，也有溫馨的親子對唱，令不同年齡的觀眾產生共鳴。本劇以視聽盛宴承載文化內涵，寓教於樂，適合全家欣賞。這個計劃亦是弘揚中華文化系列的活動之一。康文署一直積極推廣中國歷史和文化，透過舉辦多元化的節目和活動，讓市民認識博大精深的中華文化，想獲得更多資訊，請瀏覽網頁www.lcsd.gov.hk/tc/ccpo/index.html。如遇特殊情況，主辦機構保留更換節目、表演者、講者及導師的權利。 'The True Martial Way' is an original family musical that fuses Chinese martial arts with captivating melodies.  Guided by the core principle of "integrating martial arts into music and filling the heart with music", the performance presents touching tunes, striking martial arts scenes and a warm and humorous plot to convey the traditional Chinese wisdom of "ending conflict through martial arts and valuing harmony above all".  The performance showcases martial arts that balance strength with grace, strength with softness, blending music and dance to illustrate the harmony between the philosophies of power and compassion.  The music integrates traditional Chinese music with modern arrangements, featuring uplifting martial fight scores as well as tender parent-child duets which resonate with audiences of all ages.  It is a feast for the senses, a carrier of cultural essence, and an educational yet entertaining production for the enjoyment of the whole family.  The project is also one of the activities in the Chinese Culture Promotion Series. The LCSD has all along promoted Chinese history and culture through organising an array of programmes and activities to enable the public learn more about broad and profound Chinese culture. For more information, please visit www.lcsd.gov.hk/en/ccpo/index.html.  The presenter reserves the right to substitute performers, speakers, instructors, and change the programme should unavoidable circumstances make it necessary.

title: 2026社區文化大使: 香港夏威夷小結他總會「Ukulele共融樂章」Ukulele Carnival共融嘉年華會
title_en: Community Cultural Ambassador 2026: The Ukulele Society of Hong Kong 'Ukulele Harmony Movement' Ukulele Inclusion Carnival
description: 計劃以「小結他串連社區」為核心，透過 Ukulele 的輕鬆樂韻，促進不同背景人士之間的互動與共融，當中包括傷健共融、跨代共融、跨種族共融及中西樂共融。計劃旨在提升藝術參與，透過 Ukulele 表演及互動活動，讓不同社群親身體驗音樂帶來的樂趣；同時推動社會共融，與傷健人士、長者及少數族裔等群體合作，打破隔閡，共建和諧社區。 This project centers on the theme of "Linking Communities Through Ukulele," using the instrument's light and relaxing music to foster interaction and inclusion among people from diverse backgrounds, including individuals with disabilities, different generations, various ethnic groups, and communities representing both Eastern and Western cultures.  It aims to enhance artistic participation by offering ukulele performances and interactive activities that allow people from different communities to experience the joy of music.  At the same time, it seeks to promote social inclusion by collaborating with people with disabilities, the elderly, and ethnic minorities to break down barriers and build a more harmonious community.

title: 文化遊樂「元」─Gen_講故仔
title_en: Cultural Playground@Yuen Long - Community Story Challenge
description:
重塑真實的故事　感受劇場帶來的感動

一連三場的戲劇工作坊，透過一人一故事劇場（Playback Theatre）的形式將個人真實的生命經驗，重塑成戲劇與其他參加者分享。一同經歷一場與戲劇導師及其他參加者的對話，透過戲劇進一步認識自己和理解他人。

在工作坊中，你將會學到及經歷：
●	戲劇知識和表演技巧
●	與自己和他人的對話
●	透過戲劇說出你的故事 Embrace our Feelings. Experience the Power of Theatre!

This is a journey of understanding yourself and others. Through 3 sessions of Playback Theatre workshop, you will retell your life stories and get to know one another through theatre.

In this workshop, you will:
●	Gain theatre knowledge and performing skills
●	Engage in conversation with yourself and others
●	Tell your story through drama

title: 文化遊樂「元」─藝聚屏山
title_en: Cultural Playground@Yuen Long - Ping Shan Living Theatre
description:
原創互動體驗劇場！
讓觀眾跳出舞台限制，走進真正的文化古蹟，零距離體驗戲劇！

穿越百年前屏山圍村　從過去尋覓未來方向
少女一山為人生未來費煞思量，機緣巧合穿越至百年前的屏山圍村，遇上為家族未來發奮向學的子健。現代少女巧遇舊時學子，今日價值觀激撞昔日思想，又會擦出怎樣的火花？ Ancient stories, timeless virtues

Step back in time with the protagonist and relive the rich history of Ping Shan. Watch the past come alive and be inspired by timeless virtues as you journey along the Heritage Trail.

Immerse yourself in Hong Kong’s traditional culture through promenade theatre, guided tours, and workshops in this ancient site, surrounded by monuments and historic buildings. Come discover the beauty of local history at Ping Shan.

少女一山為人生未來費煞思量，機緣巧合穿越至百年前的屏山圍村，遇上為家族未來發奮向學的子健。現代少女巧遇舊時學子，今日價值觀激撞昔日思想，又會擦出怎樣的火花？ Ancient stories, timeless virtues

Step back in time with the protagonist and relive the rich history of Ping Shan. Watch the past come alive and be inspired by timeless virtues as you journey along the Heritage Trail.

Immerse yourself in Hong Kong’s traditional culture through promenade theatre, guided tours, and workshops in this ancient site, surrounded by monuments and historic buildings. Come discover the beauty of local history at Ping Shan.

description:
“e stands for electronic”

香港天籟敦煌樂團組織的電子團隊「GDEe」，將會結合中樂與電子音樂，以未來的聲響演繹過去的故事：以古老的傳說作為靈感，取得向前邁進的視野，踏入全新征途。 “e stands for electronic”

Hong Kong Gaudeamus Dunhuang Ensemble’s electronic team “GDEe” will combine Chinese music with electronic music, presenting stories of the past through futuristic soundscapes. Drawing inspiration from ancient legends, the ensemble seeks a forward-looking vision as it embarks on a new journey.

title: 香港大會堂場地伙伴計劃：貝多芬第三鋼琴協奏曲
title_en: Hong Kong City Hall Venue Partnership Scheme: "Great Piano Concertos": Sunwook Kim & Beethoven
description:
指揮/鋼琴	金善昱 Sunwook Kim
 
節目
貝多芬	
C小調第三鋼琴協奏曲，作品37

貝多芬	
F大調第六交響曲，作品68，「田園」


韓國鋼琴名家金善昱載譽回歸，他將以雙重身份登上舞台，以指揮兼鋼琴獨奏身份與香港小交響樂團一起演繹兩首貝多芬劃時代鉅作。2006年以年僅18歲之齡及首位亞洲人勇奪利茲國際鋼琴大賽冠軍的金善昱，以深刻細膩的音樂觸覺和宏大的藝術視野享譽國際，近年他的指揮事業同時如日方中，2021年，他首次執棒指揮KBS交響樂團，翌年獲邀指揮首爾愛樂樂團，並於2024/2025樂季擔任京畿愛樂樂團音樂總監。

音樂會上，他將指揮及演奏貝多芬充滿戲劇張力的第三鋼琴協奏曲，展現作曲家由古典邁向浪漫時期的革新精神；下半場則帶領樂團奏響充滿生命力的第六交響曲「田園」，以潺潺溪流、鄉間舞曲與風暴過後的寧靜景致，勾勒出作曲家對大自然的熱愛與讚頌，一起走進貝多芬激情與恬靜交織的音樂世界。 Conductor/Piano	Sunwook Kim
 
Programme
Beethoven	
Piano Concerto No 3 in C minor, Op 37

Beethoven	
Symphony No 6 in F, Op 68, “Pastorale”

Viola: Ringo Chan, Tang Wing-shuen Rebecca

title: 香港大會堂場地伙伴計劃：Panasonic呈獻 音樂劇《狼狽行動》
title_en: Hong Kong City Hall Venue Partnership Scheme: Panasonic proudly sponsors "Operation Oops! - the Musical"
description:
幫你上車？綁你上車！
 
聲稱「幫你上車」的樓盤慘變爛尾，被逼入絕境的小人物，竟然發動「綁你上車」的狼狽行動。這群有預謀、無預算的雜牌軍，到底會計劃成功，抑或狼狽告終？
 
澳門著名劇作家李宇樑改編其得獎小說《狼狽行動》為音樂劇，由精英團隊炮製，高世章、方俊杰繼《大狀王》及《奮青樂與路》後再度聯手，以音樂外送回憶，讓荒誕衝擊正義，笑看當代都市人的困境與掙扎。 Help you get your first flat? I'll kidnap you first!
 
A housing development that claims to help first-time buyers goes bust. Disenfranchised, common folks decide to kidnap the real estate developer. This group of ragtags may have a plan, but they have no foresight. Will they succeed or fail?
 
Renowned Macao playwright Lawrence Lei I Leong adapted his prize-winning novel "Wolf Hunt" as a musical, collaborating with a group of crème-de-la-crème artists. Leon Ko and Fong Chun Kit—the winning duo of such hits as "The Impossible Trial" and "Sing Out"—reunite in this musical in which songs evoke memories and farcical plots contend justice, deriding the desperation of urbanites today.

title_en: Hong Kong Cultural Centre Venue Partnership Scheme: China Life (Overseas) Proudly Sponsors: New Year Celebration: Amour & Adieu
description:
小約翰．史特勞斯｜《酒、女人與歌》，op. 333
法雅｜《七首西班牙民謠》
比才｜《卡門》選段
海頓｜升F小調第四十五交響曲，Hob I:45，「告別」
拉威爾｜《波萊羅》

今年新年音樂會先由小約翰．史特勞斯洋溢慶典歡愉、充滿生活意趣的圓舞曲《酒、女人與歌》醖釀節日氣氛。法雅的《七首西班牙民謠》及比才的《卡門》節奏明快，旋律熱情，使人情緒更加高漲。海頓的「告別」交響曲，以出人意表、妙趣橫生的終樂章，向悄然離去的舊年致意；拉威爾的《波萊羅》則由簡單旋律開始，不斷迴旋的管弦樂織體推向壯麗的終結，精神抖擻地迎接新一年。 J STRAUSS II | Wein, Weib und Gesang, op. 333
FALLA | Siete canciones populares españolas
BIZET | Carmen excerpts
HAYDN | Symphony no. 45 in F sharp minor, Hob I:45, Farewell
RAVEL | Boléro

This year’s New Year concert opens with Wein, Weib und Gesang by J Strauss II, a light-hearted waltz which embodies the effervescent spirit of a festive celebration. The energy grows higher with the vibrant rhythms and passionate melodies of Falla’s Siete cancionespopulares españolas and Bizet’s Carmen. Haydn’s Farewell Symphony offers a poignant nod to the departing year with its surprising and witty finale. Ravel’s Boléro begins with a simple theme, masterfully layering orchestral textures into a hypnotic, magnificent crescendo, in anticipation of an exciting new year.

title: 香港文化中心場地伙伴計劃：格拉斯與約翰．亞當斯生日快樂
title_en: Hong Kong Cultural Centre Venue Partnership Scheme: Happy Birthday Philip Glass & John Adams
description:
約翰．亞當斯｜《快速機器的短途旅程》
格拉斯｜第二小提琴協奏曲，「美國四季」
約翰．亞當斯｜《和聲教案》

這場想像與觀感的盛宴，將聚焦於約翰．亞當斯與格拉斯兩位美國作曲大師，展現極致的管弦當代美學與情感張力。格拉斯的「美國四季」由港樂樂團首席王敬擔綱獨奏，啟發自韋華第《四季》，但並無明確標註那段音樂代表個別季節，交由聽眾想像游走於四時流轉之間。港樂駐團指揮廖國敏領導樂團演出《快速機器的短途旅程》，以驚人速度感挑戰極限。《和聲教案》則以層疊有致的管弦織體營造強勁的衝擊力，是二十世紀音樂的重要作品。 John ADAMS | Short Ride in a Fast Machine
Philip GLASS | Violin Concerto no. 2, The American Four Seasons
John ADAMS | Harmonielehre
 

Celebrating Two Great American Composers

A visceral feast for the senses, this programme pushes the boundaries of musical imagination through the mastery of two important American composers. Jing Wang, Concertmaster of the HK Phil, takes centre stage for Glass’s The American Four Seasons, an evocative work that invites listeners to interpret the seasons through their own imagination. HK Phil’s Resident Conductor Lio Kuokman leads in Adams’s high-octane Short Ride in a Fast Machine and the monumental Harmonielehre, a powerful, immersive journey through intricately woven layers of concentrated orchestral texture.

title: 香港文化中心場地伙伴計劃：HKCO4U — 薪火相傳
title_en: Hong Kong Cultural Centre Venue Partnership Scheme: HKCO4U — Passing the Torch
description:
「 HKCO4U」作為香港中樂團精心打磨的品牌系列，始終秉持「 小而精」的藝術美學，為樂團新秀與青年精英搭建一方施展才藝、閃耀光芒的專屬舞台。本場「 薪火相傳」音樂會，誠邀當代粵樂宗師、高胡名家余其偉先生親臨坐鎮，擔任藝術指導。

演出由樂團畢業於香港演藝學院的青年演奏家擔綱，巧妙點題「薪火相傳」，這不僅是一場音樂會，更是對樂團「 植根傳統、銳意創新、不拘一格、自成一體」十六字藝術方針的生動實踐。他們以「新」生代的青春英氣，演繹源遠流長的「傳」統經典，讓新生代的臉孔與傳統音樂的聽覺享受交融碰撞，編織出一場跨越時空的新舊對話，讓古老樂種煥發出生氣勃勃的時代神采。

韻味深長的廣東音樂和柔美秀麗的江南絲竹，將在這裡融匯共鳴。多樣化的五架頭、七架頭以至硬弓五架頭編制，將立體勾勒出中國南北絲竹樂種的萬千氣象。

樂音之外，現場更將穿插對這兩種樂種特色的深度導賞，引領觀眾在弦索之間領略其背後的深厚文化意涵。誠邀觀眾蒞臨見證，在裊裊餘音中感受那份生生不息的藝術薪火。 Our signature series epitomises the artistic credo of “small but exquisite”, providing a dedicated stage for emerging talents and young virtuosi. For this “Passing the Torch” concert, we welcome the renowned Cantonese musicmaster and gaohu virtuoso Yu Qiwei as Artistic Advisor.

This concert features outstanding young graduates of the Hong Kong Academy for Performing Arts. “Passing the Torch” here vividly embodies the orchestra’s philosophy: “From traditional roots, to cutting-edge visionary. Embracing diversity and eclectic styles”. Artists with youthful vitality interpret the classics, creating a dynamic dialogue among generations, breathing vibrant contemporary energy into ancient traditions. 

The profound charm of Cantonese music and the graceful elegance of Jiangnan silk-and-bamboo resonate together on stage, as diverse small ensemble configurations portray the rich and varied Chinese soundscapes from north to south.

And who knows – there may even be a surprise waiting to be discovered!

title: 香港文化中心場地伙伴計劃：李錦記全力支持：2026 香港鼓樂節：鼓王群英會
title_en: Hong Kong Cultural Centre Venue Partnership Scheme: Lee Kum Kee Proudly Supports: Hong Kong Drum Festival 2026: Majestic Drums
description:
作為香港鼓樂節的年度盛事， 「鼓王群英會」始終以震撼人心的節奏、澎湃的生命力與觀眾共鳴。本場音樂會邀請了來自馬來西亞、在「鼓動心弦 連結世界」系列活動中備受好評的「人人人鼓劇場」擔綱演出，載譽重演多首展現馬來西亞多元文化色彩的激昂曲目。 



鼓聲是跨越國界的語言。在本場音樂會中，觀眾將領略到打擊樂的多重面貌：從改編自婆羅洲民謠、充滿土地質感的《我是那個誰》，到以印尼民謠為靈感的《哎喲媽媽》，再到展現當代敲擊力度的《衝》。此外，更有經典的敲擊協奏曲《龍騰虎躍》及由鍾耀光創作的《打擊協奏曲》第三樂章，將鼓樂的磅礴氣勢與樂團的交響織體完美融合。除了國際鼓藝的交流，本場音樂會亦是「未來鼓王」展現鋒芒的舞台。鼓聲激盪，熱血沸騰，在萬鼓齊鳴的震撼中，感受這份聯結世界的節奏力量。 As the flagship event of the Hong Kong Drum Festival, “MAJESTIC DRUMS” captivates audiences with pulsating rhythms and boundless energy. This concert highlights the acclaimed Orang Orang Drum Theatre returning from their highly praised performances in “One Beat, One World: Connecting through the Drum” in 2024, delivering a showcase of the Southeast Asian country’s rich multicultural heritage.



The language of the drum knows no borders. In this concert, audiences will experience the many facets of percussion—from the earthy, folk-inspired Tuyang Sit in the Corner (adapted from Bornean melodies), to the lively Indonesian-inspired Aiyo… Mama!, and the explosive contemporary piece Charge. Classic works such as Flying Dragons and Leaping Tigers and the third movement of Yiu Kwong Chung’s Percussion Concerto seamlessly blend drumming’s majestic power with rich symphonic textures. Beyond international exchange, this programme shines a spotlight on “future drum kings”. Let thunderous drums ignite your passion! Immerse yourself in the electrifying power of rhythms that connect the world.

title: 香港文化中心場地伙伴計劃：Liza & Friends摯友樂聚VIII — 香港中樂團籌款晚會
title_en: Hong Kong Cultural Centre Venue Partnership Scheme: Liza & Friends VIII — HKCO Fundraising Gala
description:
作為香港中樂團的年度慈善盛會，「 Liza & Friends 摯友樂聚」系列不僅是一場音樂的慶典，更是一次愛心與社會責任的深度連結。邁入第八屆，汪明荃小姐與曾鈺成先生將分別以籌款委員會主席與聯合主席的身份，率領一眾社會賢達與樂團摯友，用悠揚樂韻傳遞溫暖，為樂團的發展及社會公益事業籌募經費。

本場音樂會彰顯了「藝術回饋社會」的精神。汪明荃小姐多年來積極參與慈善與公益活動，她對藝術的執著與對社會的關懷，在舞台上化作動人的旋律。今年，多位來自政商及文化界的知名人士已確定傾力加盟，包括戴世豪、陳培甡、鄔友正、劉石佑、蔡德儀、甄美薇、李惠雄、周詠璇及謝雪心。阿姐將聯同這群善心摯友，以精湛才藝共譜溫馨動人的樂章；演出亦將精選多首跨越時代的經典名曲，從大氣磅礴的家國情懷到婉約動人的宋詞改編，帶來多元豐富的聽覺饗宴。

音樂的力量在於其能跨越藩籬、凝聚人心。透過「 摯友樂聚」 這個平台，各界人士齊聚一堂，共同支持中樂藝術的薪火相傳，讓音樂成為聯結彼此、回饋社會的橋樑，譜寫出一份珍貴而深刻的摯友真情。 As the HKCO’s flagship charity event, “Liza & Friends” — now in its eighth edition — is a musical celebration that also attests to compassion and social responsibility. Liza Wang and Jasper Tsang, along with distinguished members of society and cherished friends of the orchestra, use the power of beautiful music to spread warmth and raise funds for the orchestra’s ongoing development and community programmes. 

Embodying the spirit of “art giving back to society”, this concert again highlights Wang, a consummate artist committed to charity and community. A host of prominent figures from the political, business and cultural sectorshave agreed to join her on stage — among them David Tai, Calvin Chan, James Wu, John Lau, Lanzy Choy, Salina Yan, David Lee, Charlene Zhou and Susan Tse — showcasing their talents for a heartwarmingevening and musical feast spanning different eras of acclaimed classics, from patriotic songs to lyrical adaptationsof Song dynasty poetry. 

The power of music lies in its ability to transcend barriers and bring people together. People from all walks of life gather on this occasion to support and sustain the legacy of Chinese orchestral music. Music is a bridge connecting us all, giving back to society and bearing witness to true friendships.

title: 香港文化中心場地伙伴計劃：勞力士榮譽呈獻：費雷茲歌劇盛會
title_en: Hong Kong Cultural Centre Venue Partnership Scheme: Rolex Proudly Presents: Juan Diego Flórez Opera Gala
description:
新「高音C之王」萬眾矚目的香港首演

當今歌劇界最具魅力之一的男高音費雷茲享譽樂壇，以精湛絕倫的美聲技巧席捲全球歌劇殿堂。生於秘魯的費雷茲曾獲秘魯政府頒發最高榮譽勳章，他亦創辦「秘魯交響樂」青少音樂計劃，透過音樂推動社會共融。他曾於米蘭斯卡拉歌劇院與維也納國家歌劇院、紐約大都會歌劇院及倫敦皇家歌劇院等演出，所到之處風靡無數樂迷。這次來港首演，是一次近距離感受其藝術魅力的珍貴機會，為樂迷呈獻羅西尼、唐尼采弟、馬斯奈及威爾第等的多首詠嘆調，絕對不容錯過。 Long‑awaited Hong Kong Debut of the New “King of High Cs”

One of the most charismatic stars in opera today, Juan Diego Flórez has captivated audiences at The Metropolitan Opera, Teatro alla Scala, the Royal Opera House, and beyond. Renowned for his breathtaking bel canto artistry, the Peruvian tenor is also the founder of Sinfonía por el Perú, a transformative initiative bringing music to underprivileged youth. Flórez’s highly anticipated Hong Kong debut offers a rare opportunity to experience this world-class vocal powerhouse in arias by Rossini, Donizetti, Massenet, Verdi, among others. A truly unmissable event for all music lovers.

title: 香港文化中心場地伙伴計劃：安全貨倉集團振萬廣場全力支持: 2026香港活力鼓令24式擂台賽 小學組及自由式組決賽及頒獎禮
title_en: Hong Kong Cultural Centre Venue Partnership Scheme: Safety Godown Group LU Plaza Proudly Supports: 2026 Hong Kong Synergy 24 Drum Competition Final Round Competition and Award Ceremony
description:
震天鼓角，響徹香江。作為香港年度矚目的文化盛事，「香港活力鼓令24式擂台賽」已昂然邁向第二十四個年頭。這是一場節奏與力量的巔峰對決，更是中樂鼓藝普及與傳承的生動見證。



擂台賽延續歷年的傳統，由樂團廣發「英雄帖」，召集各路鼓樂精英齊聚一堂。在決賽當日，香港文化中心廣場將化身為熱血沸騰的鼓海。台上將上演「中國鼓樂組」之小學組及自由式組的決賽好戲，各路好手將施展渾身解數，以鏗鏘有力的鼓點一決高下；與此同時，於各組別中脫穎而出的優勝隊伍，亦將輪流登台獻技，展現多元鼓藝的極致魅力。每一次揮槌，每一聲震動，皆凝聚著參賽者的汗水與熱忱，完美體現出香港自強不息的拼搏精神！ Thunderous drumbeats echo throughout Hong Kong. One of the most anticipated cultural events, the “Hong Kong Synergy 24 Drum Competition” proudly enters its 24th year. This spectacular showdown of rhythm and strength is a vibrant testimony to the popular outreach and legacy of the Chinese art of drumming.



As always, the orchestra issues its annual “open call” inviting drum ensembles from all backgrounds to compete, and the Hong Kong Cultural Centre Piazza resounds in a vast sea of drums—not only for the finals of the Chinese Drumming Category for the Primary School Group and Open Group but also when other award-winning teams take their turn. Every drumbeat embodies participants’ sweat, passion and indomitable spirit, aptly reflecting Hong Kong’s unyielding drive for excellence.

擂台賽延續歷年的傳統，由樂團廣發「英雄帖」，召集各路鼓樂精英齊聚一堂。在決賽當日，香港文化中心廣場將化身為熱血沸騰的鼓海。台上將上演「中國鼓樂組」之小學組及自由式組的決賽好戲，各路好手將施展渾身解數，以鏗鏘有力的鼓點一決高下；與此同時，於各組別中脫穎而出的優勝隊伍，亦將輪流登台獻技，展現多元鼓藝的極致魅力。每一次揮槌，每一聲震動，皆凝聚著參賽者的汗水與熱忱，完美體現出香港自強不息的拼搏精神！ Thunderous drumbeats echo throughout Hong Kong. One of the most anticipated cultural events, the “Hong Kong Synergy 24 Drum Competition” proudly enters its 24th year. This spectacular showdown of rhythm and strength is a vibrant testimony to the popular outreach and legacy of the Chinese art of drumming.



As always, the orchestra issues its annual “open call” inviting drum ensembles from all backgrounds to compete, and the Hong Kong Cultural Centre Piazza resounds in a vast sea of drums—not only for the finals of the Chinese Drumming Category for the Primary School Group and Open Group but also when other award-winning teams take their turn. Every drumbeat embodies participants’ sweat, passion and indomitable spirit, aptly reflecting Hong Kong’s unyielding drive for excellence.

title: 香港文化中心場地伙伴計劃：渣打環球私人銀行榮譽呈獻：馬友友的艾爾加
title_en: Hong Kong Cultural Centre Venue Partnership Scheme: Standard Chartered Global Private Bank Proudly Sponsors: Yo-Yo Ma Plays Elgar
description:
艾爾加｜《威儀堂堂》第一進行曲，op. 39/1
佛漢威廉士｜《英國民謠組曲》
陳其鋼｜《京劇瞬間》
艾爾加｜E小調大提琴協奏曲，op. 85

大提琴大師馬友友再度登上港樂舞台，演奏深邃動人的艾爾加協奏曲！同場還有艾爾加的《威儀堂堂》第一進行曲──BBC 逍遙音樂節每年必唱的《希望與榮耀之地》旋律便是自此曲──以及另一位重要英國作曲家佛漢威廉士的《英國民謠組曲》。陳其鋼早年師隨法國作曲大師梅湘，《京劇瞬間》參考傳統京劇元素，融合管弦樂技法，聽感層次豐富，展現京劇音樂的色彩。 ELGAR | Pomp and Circumstance March no. 1, op. 39/1
VAUGHAN WILLIAMS | English Folk Song Suite
CHEN Qigang | Instants d'un Opéra de Pékin
ELGAR | Cello Concerto in E minor, op. 85

Cello master Yo-Yo Ma returns to the HK Phil’s stage to perform Elgar’s deeply moving Cello Concerto. The programme also includes Elgar’s Pomp and Circumstance March no. 1 – whose melody is used in Land of Hope and Glory, the must-sing song in the BBC Proms – and Vaughan Williams’s English Folk Song Suite. Chen Qigang studied under Olivier Messiaen in his youth, his work Instants d'un Opéra de Pékin draws on traditional Peking Opera elements and integrates orchestral techniques, creating a deeply textured soundscape woven with the colours of Peking Opera music.

title: 香港文化中心場地伙伴計劃：太古輕鬆樂聚系列：杜博斯與魔幻的萊格管風琴
title_en: Hong Kong Cultural Centre Venue Partnership Scheme: Swire Denim Series: Vincent Dubois and the Magic of the Rieger Organ
description:
史特勞斯｜《節日序曲》，op. 61
哈察都量｜《嘉雅妮》組曲
聖桑｜ C小調第三交響曲，op. 78，「管風琴」

盡情沉浸於香港文化中心無與倫比的萊格管風琴聲響世界吧——神聖莊嚴、變化多端、超凡脫俗！巴黎聖母院四位首席管風琴師之一的杜博斯，再度與港樂攜手演出，夥拍屢獲殊榮的指揮伊曼紐爾．捷勒窩利安，上演李察．史特勞斯的《節日序曲》和深受樂迷喜愛、旋律豐富的聖桑第三交響曲，將8,000支音管的音色發揮得淋漓盡致，令人屏息讚歎。居於維也納的捷勒窩利安，親自編彙《嘉雅妮》組曲，展現哈察都量音樂的豐沛能量。 STRAUSS | Festliches Präludium, op. 61
KHACHATURIAN | Gayane Suite
SAINT-SAËNS | Symphony no.3 in C minor, op. 78, Organ

Immerse yourself in the majestic, versatile and otherworldly soundscapes of the Hong Kong Cultural Centre’s magnificent Rieger organ, brought vividly to life by one of the four titular organists of Notre-Dame de Paris, Vincent Dubois. Joined by award-winning conductor Emmanuel Tjeknavorian, Dubois makes a welcome return to the HK Phil with two masterworks for his instrument: Richard Strauss’s Festliches Präludium and Saint-Saëns’s beloved, melody-rich Third Symphony, placing the 8,000-pipe organ in dazzling, commanding focus. Vienna-based Tjeknavorian prepares his special arrangement of Khachaturian’s Gayane in showcasing the high-octane Armenian pulses.

title: 香港文化中心場地伙伴計劃：貝托祺的布魯赫納四
title_en: Hong Kong Cultural Centre Venue Partnership Scheme: Tarmo Peltokoski Conducts Bruckner 4
description: 布魯赫納的「浪漫」交響曲猶如一幅中世紀的壯麗畫卷，在音樂中緩緩展開。以睿智、自信及對樂譜的絕對尊重見稱，貝托祺為布魯赫納恢宏的音樂構想注入清新而紮實的詮釋，讓綿長的結構自然說話。在這位新任音樂總監的帶領下，港樂遊走於力量與清晰之間，從黎明的「起床號角」、訴說「未竟之愛」的葬禮進行曲，到刺激的狩獵場景，最終抵達終樂章燦爛而歡騰的慶典。音樂會先由赫姆森演奏莫扎特C小調第二十四鋼琴協奏曲，《BBC音樂雜誌》盛讚他擁有「清澈通透的音色」，其演繹將為樂曲注入優雅與內涵。 Bruckner’s Romantic Symphony unfolds as a vivid tapestry of medieval imagery. Known for his intelligence, confidence and uncompromising respect for the score, Peltokoski brings a fresh yet deeply grounded approach to Bruckner’s expansive vision, allowing the music’s long-breathed architecture to speak with natural authority. With the HK Phil, the newly appointed Music Director balances power and clarity, from the dawn’s “reveille” and the funeral march of “unrequited love” to the great hunt, culminating in a radiant, festive finale. The programme opens with Mozart’s Piano Concerto no. 24 in C minor, performed by Martin Helmchen, a pianist praised by BBC Music Magazine for his “wonderfully limpid piano tone”, bringing elegance and depth to one of Mozart’s most searching concertos.

title: 香港文化中心場地伙伴計劃：貝托祺的布魯赫納七
title_en: Hong Kong Cultural Centre Venue Partnership Scheme: Tarmo Peltokoski Conducts Bruckner 7
description:
史特勞斯｜《最後四首藝術歌曲》
布魯赫納｜E大調第七交響曲，WAB 107

布魯赫納憑第四交響曲初嘗成功，同年他動筆創作第七交響曲，作品宛如一座宏偉的大教堂，在靜謐中展現其莊嚴氣度，並透過耐心、平和與從容，凝聚深厚的精神力量。新任音樂總監貝托祺指揮港樂，細緻鋪陳交響曲開首綿長的第一主題──一段彷彿來自自然，或如作曲家所相信，源於上帝的旋律──嚴謹的結構在終樂章圓滿，散發溫暖而堅定的光芒。音樂會以李察．史特勞斯晚年顛峰之作揭開序幕，女高音葛里戈里恩獻唱的《最後四首藝術歌曲》，被《紐約時報》形容為「音色閃耀，深沉而不厚重，能以優雅的清澈傳達內在的疲憊」。 STRAUSS | Vier letzte Lieder
BRUCKNER | Symphony no. 7 in E major, WAB 107
 
Penned in the same year that the composer’s Fourth Symphony first found success, Bruckner’s Seventh Symphony rises with the quiet grandeur of a vast cathedral, its spiritual strength shaped through patience, peace and poise. With the HK Phil, its newly appointed Music Director draws out the symphony’s arching first theme – a gift of nature or, as Bruckner himself believed, from God – before the work completes its circle in a finale of glowing affirmation. The programme opens with Richard Strauss’s Four Last Songs, sung by soprano Asmik Grigorian. The New York Times writes that her singing reveals “a gleaming timbre, dark but not weighty, (that) expresses psychic depletion with graceful clarity,” bringing quiet serenity to Strauss’s farewell to life.

title: 香港文化中心場地伙伴計劃：貝托祺的馬勒八
title_en: Hong Kong Cultural Centre Venue Partnership Scheme: Tarmo Peltokoski Conducts Mahler 8
description: 貝托祺以馬勒第八交響曲揭開他作為港樂音樂總監首個樂季的序幕，他認為這首龐然鉅作，「應當保留給最珍罕而特別的時刻」。這次馬勒八港樂首演，同時見證樂團完成演奏全部馬勒交響曲的歷史時刻，意義非凡。貝托祺形容這首編制龐大的交響曲「如宇宙般宏大、普世人間、超凡入聖、眾志成城」，並蘊藏着「人世間一些最深層、最原始的特質」。獲譽為「芬蘭指揮奇才」的貝托祺，聯同國際及本地精英陣容，以港樂音樂總監身份，與樂團邁向輝煌新篇章。 Tarmo Peltokoski launches his first season as Music Director of the HK Phil with Mahler’s colossal Symphony no. 8 – a score he believes “should be saved for the most special, rare occasions.” This landmark programme also marks the HK Phil premiere of Mahler’s Eighth, completing the orchestra’s long‑awaited journey through all of Mahler’s symphonies. Few works rival the scale and ambition of this masterpiece, which Peltokoski describes as “cosmic, universal, heavenly, uniting,” and filled with “some of the deepest, most primitive aspects of our existence.” A stellar lineup of international and HK artists powers this vibrant inauguration of the “Finnish conducting miracle” – a triumphant new chapter for the HK Phil under its new Music Director.

Few works rival the scale and ambition of this masterpiece, which Peltokoski describes as “cosmic, universal, heavenly, uniting,” and filled with “some of the deepest, most primitive aspects of our existence.” A stellar lineup of international and HK artists powers this vibrant inauguration of the “Finnish conducting miracle” – a triumphant new chapter for the HK Phil under its new Music Director.

title: 香港文化中心場地伙伴計劃：大師神韻
title_en: Hong Kong Cultural Centre Venue Partnership Scheme: The Spirit of the Masters
description:
繼往年於廣州星海音樂廳演出的熱烈迴響，今年11月樂團再次獲邀， 於「 粵港澳大灣區文化藝術節 」中演出「 大師神韻 — 香港中樂團經典國風音樂會」，延續粵港文化藝術交流。

「 大師神韻」 立足於深厚的歷史傳統，以人文、文學與戲曲為經緯，集中呈獻趙季平、王立平、閻惠昌及賈達群四位大師的經典力作。這些作品既是音樂大師們長期積累與思考的結晶，亦展現了傳統中樂在當代巨匠筆下的創造性轉化與創新發展。 

《國風 》由被譽為「 樂壇神筆 」 的趙季平先生創作。作品以傳統琴曲《 梅花三弄》 的主題為動機，在豐富變幻的和聲色彩中雙主題靈動變奏相互交織，既包含悲苦與困頓，更多的是忍耐與堅韌、奮進與抗爭，以此弘揚國風，展現中華神韻。 

《王立平之紅樓夢大提琴隨想曲》中樂版將於廣州星海音樂廳世界首演，及後香港場音樂會迎來香港首演。王立平先生創作的《 紅樓夢》音樂已成為幾代人心中不可替代的文化記憶，更被譽為「 二十世紀華人音樂經典」。本次演出由大提琴家李垂誼與黃學揚共同編曲、李垂誼擔綱獨奏，以一中一西的對話勾勒紅樓悲喜，重塑文學與音樂的共生關係。

賈達群的《 隨想曲．梨園竹調》 將梨園聲韻的悠揚明快融化在昆風曲調的隨想中。透過古老竹笛演繹出寧靜悠遠、靈巧玄妙的旋律，樂曲不僅講述了梨園戲班台上台下的悲歡離合，色彩斑斕的和聲更描繪出華夏神州塞北江南的絢麗景色。

於廣州星海音樂廳演出的《線狂》為閻惠昌全新創作的民族管弦樂，以其家鄉陜西合陽縣獨有的提線木偶戲曲劇種「 線腔」為創作主題，加入鼓板懷、皮弦胡及演唱等，充滿濃烈陝西韻味。這次表演邀請陝西合陽縣線腔木偶劇團皮弦胡、鼓板懷演奏家王坤，以一人之力演奏七種傳統樂器。香港場的三弦協奏曲《儺》 同由閻惠昌創作。儺祭作為中國古代三大宗教禮儀之一，在民間流傳久遠，至今猶見。作品以三弦獨特粗獷的音色調動各種音樂手法，以純音樂形式展現民間儺祭的生動場面。這首難得的三弦大型作品在音色與技巧上皆作出了大膽的新嘗試。 Following the enthusiastic response to its past performances at the Xinghai Concert Hall in Guangzhou, HKCO has been invited again this November to present “The Spirit of the Masters” at the “GBA Culture and Arts Festival”, continuing the cultural and artistic exchanges between Guangdong and Hong Kong. “The Spirit of the Masters” interweaves history with culture, literature and Xiqu, featuring masterpieces by four illustrious composers — Zhao Jiping, Wang Liping, Yan Huichang and Jia Daqun — representing consummate artistic excellence. 

Zhao’s Guo Feng ingeniously quotes the ancient tune Three Variations on Plum Blossom, building two sets of variations, adding ever-changing harmonic colours expressing not only sorrow and hardship but also endurance and resilience. 

This concert marks the world premiere of the Chinese orchestra version of Wang Liping’s The Dream of the Red Chamber Capriccio, arranged by soloist Trey Lee and Alfred Wong. Wang’s original music, having won the hearts of generations of Chinese, is now a fresh dialogue across centuries and cultures. 

Through the dizi, Jia’s Capriccio · Opera Bamboo Tunes highlights tranquil, distant, nimble and profound melodies depicting Kunqu opera troupes both on and off stage, while colourful harmonies portray splendid Chinese landscapes from the northern frontiers to the southern rivers. 

Performed at the Xinghai Concert Hall, The Puppet's Passion is a newly composed Chinese orchestral work by Yan Huichang. Inspired by "Xianqiang" (string-puppet opera) unique to his hometown of Heyang County, Shaanxi, the piece incorporates gubanhuai, pixianhu, and vocals to deliver a rich Shaanxi flavour. This performance features Wang Kun, a virtuoso from the Shaanxi Heyang County Xianqiang Puppet Troupe, who showcases his mastery of pixianhu and gubanhuai while single-handedly playing seven traditional instruments. The Hong Kong performance of Nuo—a concerto for sanxian—by Yan Huichang is inspired by one of the three major religious ceremonies in ancient China. The robust timbres and virtuosity of the sanxian capture the earthiness of age-old rituals in purely musical form.

title: 香港文化中心場地伙伴計劃：中國聯通榮譽呈獻：欽米尼亞尼卓夫的胡桃夾子
title_en: Hong Kong Cultural Centre Venue Partnership Scheme: UniCom Proudly Presents:  Maxim Emelyanychev Conducts The Nutcracker
description:
拉赫曼尼諾夫｜《岩石》，op. 7 
莫扎特 ｜C大調第二十五鋼琴協奏曲，K. 503
柴可夫斯基｜《胡桃夾子》選段

「天生的指揮家」（《BBC音樂雜誌》）——俄羅斯指揮家欽米尼亞尼卓夫率領蘇格蘭室樂團初登BBC逍遙音樂節，即以一場「令人難忘、能量澎湃的莫扎特」演出驚艷全場，並獲《衞報》盛讚為「五星級」表現。欽米尼亞尼卓夫不僅是出色的莫扎特詮釋者，同時亦是技藝精湛的鍵盤獨奏家； 這次港樂首演，他將親自擔綱獨奏，演繹莫扎特燦爛輝煌的協奏曲。他並呈獻家鄉俄羅斯的樂曲與之呼應：拉赫曼尼諾夫早期作品《岩石》，蘊含年輕作曲家與其恩師柴可夫斯基之間令人動容的深厚情誼。壓軸之際，欽米尼亞尼卓夫以輕盈靈巧的指揮身姿，在柴可夫斯基的《胡桃夾子》選段中幻化出閃爍魔法，為璀璨節日增添喜悅。 RACHMANINOV | The Rock, op. 7
MOZART | Piano Concerto no. 25 in C major, K. 503
TCHAIKOVSKY | The Nutcracker selections

“Born to conduct” (BBC Music Magazine), Russian conductor Maxim Emelyanychev and the Scottish Chamber Orchestra were hailed as “five-star” by The Guardian for an “unforgettable, supercharged Mozart” performance in their Proms debut. A gifted Mozartian and an accomplished keyboard soloist, Emelyanychev makes his HK Phil debut with Mozart’s glorious concerto, framing it with music from his native Russia. Rachmaninov’s early work, The Rock, encapsulates a poignant connection with the young composer’s mentor, Tchaikovsky. With his buoyant, dance-like physicality on the stage, Emelyanychev conjures up shimmering magic in Tchaikovsky’s delightful Nutcracker selections, perfectly ushering in a sparkling festive season.

title: 香港流行文化節2026：幸會25歲──香港電影資料館珍藏展 （香港電影資料館二十五周年誌慶節目）
title_en: Hong Kong Pop Culture Festival 2026: Hong Kong Film Archive Stories: Treasure Hunting for 25 Years (Celebrating the 25th Anniversary of the Hong Kong Film Archive)
description:
香港電影資料館踏入25周年！為與更多觀眾一同慶祝這個重要時刻，資料館首度於香港文化博物館精心呈獻「珍藏展」！從館藏超過130萬件的珍貴電影文物中，嚴選極具歷史與文化價值的瑰寶，帶領觀眾重溫銀幕光影的經典時代。

穿越閃閃發亮的「25歲影人照片隧道」，走進早期香港電影的藏寶庫，從歷年預告片速讀電影演變，欣賞絢爛奪目的戲服華裳，更可一睹影人慷慨捐贈的榮譽獎項「大觀園」！

在口述歷史區聆聽影人親述心聲，壓軸重溫資料館出版與活動的精彩足跡。多項互動裝置讓觀眾穿越時空，近距離感受香港電影文化的獨特魅力。誠邀大家蒞臨，共享這場超乎想像的光影生日盛會！

香港文化博物館協辦 The Hong Kong Film Archive marks its 25th anniversary with a special exhibition at the Hong Kong Heritage Museum. Drawing on more than 1.3 million film artefacts, the display offers a carefully curated selection of items of notable historical and cultural significance, inviting visitors to revisit the golden age of the screen.

Visitors enter via the dazzling photo tunnel of Hong Kong stars and step into a treasury of early Hong Kong cinema. A brisk sequence of historical trailers charts the medium’s development, while resplendent costumes highlight the craft of filmmaking. The “Hall of Honours” showcases awards generously donated by industry figures.

Listen to filmmakers’ deep and incisive reflections on local cinema, then explore the Archive’s publications and timeline of activities. Fun interactive installations connect audiences across time and space — this is a birthday bash not to be missed!

In collaboration with Hong Kong Heritage Museum

title: 葵青劇院場地伙伴計劃：音樂劇《邊城》
title_en: Kwai Tsing Theatre Venue Partnership Scheme: "Border Town the Musical"
description:
在交錯的渡口，軌跡相遇卻難以相守

川湘交界的邊城小鎮的角落，翠翠與擺渡的老船夫爺爺相依為命，日子純樸如歌。一日，天保與儺送兩兄弟的出現，為翠翠寧靜的生活帶來愛情的漣漪。

然而，緣分讓大家相遇，命運卻也讓彼此無緣無故地錯過。一次善意的成全，竟引發了無法挽回的離別。天保的離去，儺送的不辭而別，爺爺的一場意外⋯⋯一夜風雨，翠翠生命中最重要的人，就這樣悄然缺席。在無盡的黑夜，翠翠選擇靜候儺送的歸來。日子如常，生活如常，她將等待化為唯一的燭火，成為一道最固執、最溫柔的微光。

中英劇團伙拍北京鼓樓西戲劇共同打造，將沈從文先生的經典小說，改編為詩意盎然的音樂劇。在殿堂級音樂家鍾志榮的動人旋律，與導演司徒慧焯的細膩執導下，為這幅淡雅的鄉村水墨畫，注入斷人心腸的旋律。

^此場為通達專場，設粵語口述影像 At the crossing of rivers, paths entwine yet drift apart

In a quiet border town between Sichuan and Hunan, young Cuicui lives a simple life with her grandfather, the old ferryman. One day, the arrival of two brothers, Tianbao and Nuosong, stirs ripples of love in her tranquil world.

Yet destiny brings people together only to let them slip apart. A single act of kindness leads to irreversible separation: Tianbao’s death, Nuosong’s sudden disappearance and grandfather’s tragic accident. In one stormy night, all those dearest to Cuicui vanish. In the endless darkness, she chooses to wait and turns her longing into the sole candlelight, a stubborn yet tender glimmer that refuses to fade.

This poetic musical, adapted from Shen Congwen’s classic novel, is co-produced by Chung Ying Theatre Company and Beijing DrumTower West Theatre. With the moving melodies of maestro Chung Chi wing and the delicate direction of Roy Szeto, this timeless rural ink painting is infused with music that pierces the heart.

title: 銀齡演讀戲劇2026
description:
是次銀齡戲劇匯演2026，集合了不同劇種供觀眾選擇。
當中有以照顧者為重心的「聚光燈」; 有以莎士比亞四大悲劇及四大喜劇為主的「悦讀沙翁」之「演讀劇場」; 也有學生們自行創作的「照顧三藏的N天」。
由一班充滿熱誠的銀齡演員演出，誠邀你入場支持！

演出： 明愛安老服務明愛臻藝坊 ─ 智好戲劇團「演讀奇兵2.0」

《悅讀莎翁・喜劇篇》（十二夜軸心）
四大喜劇的共同點，是「女人」的命運均操控於父權之下。我們希望跟大家分享：面對命運安排，究竟是順天抑或抗命？ 
人生成長階段，要點就點？悉隨尊便！ 

《悅讀莎翁・悲劇篇》（李爾王軸心）
權力、慾望、困惑、嫉妒，是人生無可避免的命題。四位悲劇人物，都彷彿被困在一座監獄之中；能否逃出這個鐵窗牢籠？“To Be or Not To Be？”這依然是一個問題……！ 

《認知吹號人》
要將認知障礙症及照顧者的苦樂，以輕鬆歡懷的戲劇手法呈現出來——這正是我們這群『吹號人』最想吹響的生命樂章！ 

《照顧三藏的N天》（學生原創作品）
《西遊記》三藏取經，原來蘊藏著一個極大的「照顧者寶藏」。有了這個寶藏，究竟可以……？ 請大家來細心欣賞！ 

演出 ：基督教香港信義會頌安長者鄰舍中心 ─「五十後劇團」

《聚光燈 - 燈火照亮的每個地方》
雜貨店內一盞奇幻之燈，能發出透視人心的光芒，照亮心內每個暗處，燃起埋藏多時的愛。三位照顧者，勞累而孤寂，奇幻之燈為他們普照出希望和溫暖，在照顧路上送上力量，走出黑暗。 The 2026 Silver Age Drama Festival brings together a variety of theatrical genres for audiences to choose from. These include "Spotlight," a program focused on caregivers; a Reading Theatre showcasing Shakespeare's four great Tragedies and Comedies; and student-created works. Everyone is welcome to purchase tickets and support the Festival. Thank you!

挪威小提琴家兼哈當厄小提琴家黎曉黛‧夏星，從她的北歐民間音樂傳統汲取靈感，為葛利格歷久彌新的旋律注入嶄新音樂視野。韋華第筆下的鳥鳴風吟、狂風暴雨、冰雪寒霜，也在她的北歐音樂世界中激起深刻共鳴。這將是一個充滿熟悉旋律、卻又洋溢清新色彩的難忘晚上。
